We evaluated seven models, including a genotype-only model (G), metabolite-only models using metabolite-profile data from 10-week (M1), 20-week (M2), or both timepoints (M1+M2), and combined models integrating genotypes with metabolite-profile data (G+M1, G+M2, G+M1+M2). Results Heritability estimates were generally low to moderate, ranging from 0.08 to 0.23 for the 10-week metabolite profiles and from 0.07 to 0.26 for the 20-week metabolite profiles. Prediction accuracy of phenotypes consistently improved when metabolite-profile data were integrated into prediction models, although the magnitude of improvement varied depending on the trait and the timepoint of metabolite sampling. Prediction accuracy increased from 0.33 (G) to 0.42 (G+M2; G+M1+M2) for DFI, and from 0.27 (G) to 0.32 (G+M2; G+M1+M2) for FCR. The latter two models also delivered the largest gains over G for BF (from 0.39 to 0.46) and TDG (from 0.30 to 0.32). However, LD benefited the most when both 10-week and 20-week metabolite profiles were combined (G+M1+M2: 0.44 compared to G: 0.42). Conclusions Across all traits, models combining genotype data with metabolite profiles from one or multiple timepoints achieved the highest or equally high phenotype prediction accuracies compared to the genotype-only model, reflecting complementary biological insights captured by metabolite profiles. These findings highlight the potential value of metabolite-profile data as an intermediate omics layer to enhance phenotypic prediction, particularly when integration strategies are tailored to trait-specific biology and sampling timepoints.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：準確預測表型對於評估個別豬隻的實際生產性能至關重要，特別是用於那些成本高昂或難以直接測量的性狀。本研究探討了將兩個發育階段（10週齡與20週齡）採樣之個體血清代謝物譜整合至表型預測模型的潛力，研究對象涵蓋五個具經濟重要性的性狀：平均日採食量（DFI）、飼料換肉率（FCR）、背脂厚度（BF）、檢定日增重（TDG）以及背肌深度（LD）。本研究採用 BayesC 模型框架，分析了來自單一純種族群、具備完整表型、基因型及代謝物譜數據的 1,637 頭豬隻。我們評估了七種模型，包含僅使用基因型的模型（G）、僅使用 10 週齡（M1）、20 週齡（M2）或兩個時間點（M1+M2）代謝物譜數據的模型，以及整合基因型與代謝物譜數據的綜合模型（G+M1、G+M2、G+M1+M2）。結果：遺傳力估計值普遍偏低至中等，10 週齡代謝物譜的遺傳力介於 0.08 至 0.23 之間，20 週齡代謝物譜則介於 0.07 至 0.26 之間。當代謝物譜數據被整合至預測模型中時，表型預測準確度皆呈現一致的提升，儘管提升的幅度會因性狀及代謝物採樣的時間點而異。對於 DFI，預測準確度從 0.33（G）提升至 0.42（G+M2；G+M1+M2）；對於 FCR，則從 0.27（G）提升至 0.32（G+M2；G+M1+M2）。後兩者模型在 BF（從 0.39 提升至 0.46）和 TDG（從 0.30 提升至 0.32）上，也取得了相較於 G 模型最大的增幅。然而，LD 在結合 10 週齡與 20 週齡代謝物譜時獲益最大（G+M1+M2：0.44，相較於 G：0.42）。結論：在所有性狀中，結合基因型數據與一個或多個時間點代謝物譜的模型，相較於僅使用基因型的模型，皆達到了最高或同等高的表型預測準確度，這反映出代謝物譜所捕捉到的互補性生物學見解。這些發現突顯了代謝物譜數據作為中間體學（omics）層次以增強表型預測的潛在價值，特別是在整合策略針對性狀特異性生物學特性與採樣時間點進行調整時。

papers.title: Multi-omics reveals that dietary Piper sarmentosum Roxb. extract improves goat meat quality via the microbiota–muscle amino acid metabolic axis
papers.abstract: Background Improving meat quality through nutritional regulation is an important approach in ruminant production. Growing evidence suggests that rumen microbiota influences host metabolism via microbial metabolites, thereby affecting meat quality. However, whether Piper sarmentosum Roxb. extract (PSE), a medicinal and edible plant-derived extract, improves meat quality through rumen microbiota–host metabolic interactions remains unclear. Thirty-six weaned male Hainan black goats (approximately 3 months old) were randomly assigned to four dietary treatments supplemented with 0, 200, 400, or 600 mg/kg PSE (dry matter basis), respectively. After a 90-day feeding trial, goats were fasted for 12 h before slaughter, and rumen and longissimus lumborum muscle samples were collected for subsequent analyses. Results Supplementation with 600 mg/kg PSE significantly enhanced meat quality traits, including higher ultimate pH, improved color stability, and increased water-holding capacity, without affecting growth performance or carcass traits. Transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses revealed that PSE supplementation was associated with remodeling of amino acid and energy metabolism in muscle, particularly glutamate-related pathways. These metabolic changes were accompanied by increased expression of key metabolic genes, including BCAT2 , IDH1 , and IDH3A , alongside alterations in energy-related metabolites, such as the downregulation of carnitine and upregulation of creatinine. Concomitant shifts in rumen microbial composition were observed, with PSE supplementation increasing the abundance of genera like Weissella and Ruminococcus , while reducing potentially opportunistic genera, such as Acinetobacter and Klebsiella . Weissella showed strong positive correlations with elevated rumen metabolites like serine, threonine, choline, and hypoxanthine. Metagenome-assembled genome analysis of Weissella cibaria revealed an enrichment of genes related to amino acid metabolism and glycosyltransferase families. Correlation and mediation analyses further revealed associations among Weissella abundance, rumen metabolites, and muscle metabolic traits, supporting a potential microbiota–metabolite–host metabolic relationship. Conclusions Collectively, this study provides new insights into the association network linking PSE-induced alterations in rumen microbiota, microbial metabolites, and host muscle metabolism in relation to goat meat quality. These findings suggest that PSE supplementation may improve meat quality through coordinated changes in rumen microbial ecology and muscle metabolic profiles.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 透過營養調控來改善肉品品質是反芻動物生產中的重要方法。越來越多的證據表明，瘤胃微生物群透過微生物代謝物影響宿主代謝，進而影響肉品品質。然而，賈苔（Piper sarmentosum Roxb.）萃取物（PSE）這種兼具藥用與食用的植物源萃取物，是否能透過「瘤胃微生物群—宿主代謝」的交互作用來改善肉品品質，目前仍不清楚。本研究將 36 隻離乳海南黑山羊公羊（約 3 月齡）隨機分為四個日糧處理組，分別補充 0、200、400 或 600 mg/kg 的 PSE（以乾物質基礎計）。經過 90 天的飼養試驗後，山羊在屠宰前禁食 12 小時，並採集瘤胃及背最長肌樣本以進行後續分析。結果 補充 600 mg/kg 的 PSE 顯著提升了肉品品質特徵，包括較高的最終 pH 值、改善的色澤穩定性以及增加的保水力，且不影響生長性能或屠體性狀。轉錄體學與代謝體學分析顯示，PSE 補充與肌肉中胺基酸及能量代謝（特別是麩胺酸相關途徑）的重塑有關。這些代謝變化伴隨著關鍵代謝基因（包括 BCAT2、IDH1 及 IDH3A）表現量的增加，以及能量相關代謝物（如肉鹼的下調和肌酸酐的上調）的改變。同時觀察到瘤胃微生物組成的轉變，PSE 補充增加了魏斯氏菌屬（Weissella）和瘤胃球菌屬（Ruminococcus）等屬的豐度，同時減少了諸如不動桿菌屬（Acinetobacter）和克雷伯氏菌屬（Klebsiella）等潛在伺機性致病菌屬。魏斯氏菌屬與升高的瘤胃代謝物（如絲胺酸、蘇胺酸、膽鹼和次黃嘌呤）呈現強烈的正相關。對西氏魏斯氏菌（Weissella cibaria）進行的巨基因體組裝基因組（MAG）分析顯示，其胺基酸代謝及醣基轉移酶家族相關基因富集。相關性與中介分析進一步揭示了魏斯氏菌屬豐度、瘤胃代謝物與肌肉代謝特徵之間的關聯，支持了潛在的「微生物群—代謝物—宿主代謝」關係。結論 總體而言，本研究為連結 PSE 引起的瘤胃微生物群、微生物代謝物變化，以及與山羊肉品品質相關的宿主肌肉代謝之間的關聯網絡提供了新的見解。這些發現表明，補充 PSE 可能透過協調瘤胃微生物生態與肌肉代謝特徵的改變來改善肉品品質。

papers.title: Study on the Effects of Dandelion Ultrafine Powder on the Production Performance and Intestinal Microbiota of Broiler Chickens
papers.abstract: This study aimed to investigate the effects of dietary supplementation with dandelion superfine powder (DSFP) on the growth performance, organ indices, intestinal length, antioxidant parameters, cecal microbiota and economic benefits of broilers, so as to determine its optimal dosage. A total of 240 one-day-old ROSS broilers were randomly allocated into four groups fed basal diets supplemented with 0%, 0.5%, 1% and 3% DSFP, respectively. The results showed that medium-dose (1%) DSFP significantly increased the overall ADG and average daily feed intake, elevated duodenal length, and improved serum GSH-Px activity of broilers. Microbiological analysis revealed that 1% DSFP was associated with changes in the cecal microbiota structure and tended to increase the relative abundance of Firmicutes and potential short-chain fatty acid-producing bacteria. Economically, the medium-dose group achieved the highest gross profit per broiler. In conclusion, dietary supplementation with 1% DSFP can effectively improve growth performance and was associated with favorable changes in certain intestinal microbial indicators, leading to superior economic benefits, and it represents the appropriate dosage for broiler production.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討飼糧中添加蒲公英超微粉（DSFP）對肉雞生長性能、臟器指數、腸道長度、抗氧化指標、盲腸微生物菌群及經濟效益的影響，以確定其最適添加劑量。試驗選取240隻一日齡ROSS肉雞，隨機分為4組，分別飼喂添加0%、0.5%、1%和3% DSFP的基礎飼糧。結果顯示，中劑量（1%）DSFP顯著提高了肉雞的全期平均日增重和平均日採食量，增加了十二指腸長度，並改善了血清GSH-Px活性。微生物分析顯示，1% DSFP組的盲腸微生物菌群結構發生改變，並有增加厚壁菌門及潛在短鏈脂肪酸產生菌相對豐度的趨勢。在經濟效益方面，中劑量組獲得了每隻肉雞最高的毛利。綜上所述，飼糧中添加1% DSFP能有效改善生長性能，並與某些腸道微生物指標的良好改變相關，從而帶來更佳的經濟效益，是肉雞生產中的適宜添加劑量。

papers.title: Metabolic Signatures of Refrigerated Storage Linked to Quality Deterioration in Thai Native Chicken Meat: An Integrated 1H NMR-Based Metabolomics and Meat Quality Assessment
papers.abstract: Refrigeration is essential for preserving meat quality; however, understanding the biochemical mechanisms underlying deterioration during storage is crucial for extending its shelf life. This study examines the impact of refrigerated storage on the quality, metabolite profiles, and microbiological characteristics of Thai native chicken meat using physicochemical analysis and 600 MHz 1H NMR-based metabolomics. The samples were individually wrapped and stored at 4 °C and analyzed on days 1, 3, 5, 7, and 10 to evaluate pH, drip loss, cooking loss, microbial characteristics, texture, and metabolic profiles. Physicochemical assessments showed that pH and drip loss increased significantly over time, whereas color, texture profile, chemical composition, and lipid oxidation remained relatively stable. Coliform counts remained stable through day 7 before peaking on day 10. Metabolomic profiling identified 26 metabolites, primarily associated with amino acids, nucleotides, bioactive compounds, organic acids, and sugars. Chemometric analyses, including principal component analysis (PCA) and orthogonal partial least squares discriminant analysis (OPLS-DA), demonstrated continuing metabolic changes, distinctly separating day 10 samples from earlier time points. Furthermore, glutamine and N-methylhydantoin were identified as potential storage-related biomarkers. These findings indicate that day 10 represents an advanced storage phase, demonstrating the usefulness of metabolomics in evaluating freshness and elucidating shelf-life dynamics in chicken meat.
papers.abstract_zh: 冷藏對於保持肉品品質至關重要；然而，理解儲存過程中劣變背後的生化機制對於延長其保存期限至關重要。本研究利用理化分析與 600 MHz $^1\text{H}$ 核磁共振（NMR）代謝體學，探討冷藏儲存對泰國土雞肉的品質、代謝物分佈及微生物特性的影響。樣品經個別包裝後儲存於 4 °C，並於第 1、3、5、7 和 10 天進行分析，以評估 pH 值、滴水損失、蒸煮損失、微生物特性、質地與代謝分佈。理化評估顯示，pH 值和滴水損失隨時間顯著增加，而顏色、質地分佈、化學成分和脂質氧化則保持相對穩定。大腸桿菌群數量在第 7 天前保持穩定，隨後在第 10 天達到峰值。代謝體學分佈鑑定了 26 種代謝物，主要與胺基酸、核苷酸、生物活性化合物、有機酸和糖類有關。化學計量學分析，包括主成分分析（PCA）與正交偏最小二乘法判別分析（OPLS-DA），展現了持續的代謝變化，將第 10 天的樣品與早期時間點明確區分開來。此外，麩醯胺酸（glutamine）和 $N$-甲基海因（$N$-methylhydantoin）被識別為潛在的儲存相關生物標記。這些發現表明，第 10 天代表了進階的儲存階段，證明瞭代謝體學在評估雞肉新鮮度和闡明保存期限動態方面的效用。

papers.title: Spatiotemporal Dynamics and Trend Analysis of African Swine Fever Virus in Romanian Wild Boar Populations (2018–2024)
papers.abstract: Background: African Swine Fever (ASF) remains a critical threat to the swine industry globally, with wild boars (Sus scrofa) acting as a major wildlife reservoir. Romania has been one of the most severely affected European countries since the virus’s introduction. Objectives: This study aims to estimate the long-term spatiotemporal trends, environmental persistence, and transmission dynamics of ASF virus (ASFV) in the Romanian wild boar population based on a finalized dataset of 1443 confirmed cases distributed across an 80-month timeline (May 2018–December 2024). Methods: Advanced epidemiological workflows integrating spatial and temporal modeling frameworks were developed. Spatiotemporal cluster detection was performed using SatScan to identify significant disease hotspots. Generalized Additive Models (GAMs) were utilized to model non-linear seasonal trends and spatial patterns of carcass persistence. Furthermore, the time-varying reproduction number (Rt) was calculated using a Bayesian renewal framework via the EpiEstim package, parameterized with a wild boar serial distribution (mean = 10.3 days; SD = 4.2 days). Results: SatScan identified one most primary cluster in Dobrogea and five other major recurrent hot spots in Muntenia, Transylvania, and Moldova. The GAM analysis revealed a strong, statistically significant seasonal pattern, with case detection from carcasses peaking markedly during the winter months when low temperatures favor environmental virus stability. The Bayesian Rt reconstruction disclosed three distinct epidemiological phases: a sharp initial invasion peak at a mean Rt of 2.38 (95% Crl: 1.82–3.02), followed by regional wave-like oscillations, and a distinct long-term stabilization in the late endemic phase, hovering dynamically around a stationary mean of 1.01 (95% Crl: 0.87–1.16). Conclusions: Our findings statistically validate the shift from an acute epidemic wave to a self-sustaining, chronic endemic equilibrium within the natural habitat, driven by constant carcass-mediated environmental re-seeding. These insights underscore that successful disease mitigation must prioritize the rapid, targeted removal of infected carcasses in high-risk forest matrices rather than generic population reduction strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：非洲豬瘟（African Swine Fever, ASF）對全球養豬產業構成重大威脅，其中野豬（Sus scrofa）扮演主要的野生動物保毒宿主。自病毒引入以來，羅馬尼亞一直是受歐洲影響最嚴重的國家之一。目的：本研究旨在基於涵蓋 80 個月時間軸（2018 年 5 月至 2024 年 12 月）共 1,443 例確診病例的完整資料集，評估羅馬尼亞野豬族群中非洲豬瘟病毒（ASFV）的長期時空趨勢、環境持久性及傳播動態。方法：本研究開發了整合空間與時間建模框架的先進流行病學工作流程。使用 SatScan 進行時空群聚偵測，以識別顯著的疾病熱點。利用廣義加法模型（Generalized Additive Models, GAMs）對屍體持久性的非線性季節性趨勢與空間模式進行建模。此外，透過 EpiEstim 套件並使用貝氏更新框架計算時變再生數（Rt），其參數設定根據野豬的序列間隔分佈（平均值 = 10.3 天；標準差 = 4.2 天）。結果：SatScan 在多布羅加（Dobrogea）識別出一個主要核心群聚，並在蒙特尼亞（Muntenia）、特蘭 silvestris（Transylvania，註：維持原專有名詞 Transylvania 譯為特蘭西瓦尼亞）及摩爾達維亞（Moldova）識別出另外五個主要的覆發性熱點。GAM 分析顯示出強烈且具統計顯著性的季節性模式，在低溫有利於病毒在環境中穩定存活的冬季月份，從屍體中檢測到的病例數顯著達到高峰。貝氏 Rt 重建揭示了三個不同的流行病學階段：平均 Rt 為 2.38（95% 信賴區間：1.82–3.02）的急劇初始入侵高峰、隨後的區域性波浪狀振盪，以及在地方性流行後期明顯的長期穩定狀態，動態徘徊在 1.01 的平穩平均值附近（95% 信賴區間：0.87–1.16）。結論：我們的研究結果從統計學上證實了在由屍體介導的持續環境重複散播驅動下，自然棲息地內的疫情已從急性流行波轉變為自我維持的慢性地方性平衡。這些見解強調，成功的疾病緩解策略必須優先針對高風險森林基質中的受感染屍體進行快速、標靶式的移除，而非採取通用的族群減少策略。

papers.title: Beyond the Transcriptome: The m 6 A Epitranscriptome in Bovine Mastitis
papers.abstract: Bovine mastitis is a heterogeneous inflammatory disease that compromises milk production, animal welfare and dairy sustainability. Despite extensive transcriptomic and epigenomic research, a PubMed search completed in September 2026 identified only 12 primary studies addressing epitranscriptomic regulation in bovine mastitis, representing approximately 0.1% of indexed publications. This review critically evaluates N 6 ‐methyladenosine (m 6 A), the most extensively studied RNA modification in bovine mastitis, its regulatory machinery and effects on mammary immunity, while identifying m 5 C and A‐to‐I editing as priorities for mechanistic investigation. Current evidence identifies transcript‐specific RNA stability as the best‐supported mechanism and provides a foundation for investigating m 6 A‐dependent translation. Functional studies of ALKBH5– LOC4191 , YTHDF2– IER3 , YTHDF2‐associated CCL20 and CCL5 regulation, m 6 A‐regulated LncRNA7825 and FTO– FN1 demonstrate that m 6 A reshapes inflammatory signalling, mitochondrial stress, epithelial‐barrier integrity, cell survival and bacterial control. Synthesizing these findings, we propose a context‐dependent RNA‐fate checkpoint model in which biological effects depend on the modified transcript, effector protein, pathogen, cellular context and infection phase. The FTO– FN1 axis shows that bacterial control and tissue protection can diverge, establishing them as complementary outcomes. Future studies should test whether m 6 A provides an early post‐transcriptional response layer and whether pathogens manipulate it, using time‐resolved multi‐omics, nucleotide‐specific perturbation, primary cells, mammary organoids and longitudinal cattle samples. Parallel profiling of non‐m 6 A modifications should define interacting regulatory layers. These approaches should establish causal modification sites, resolve pathogen‐specific regulation, connect molecular mechanisms with disease trajectories, and support validated milk‐based biomarkers, mammary‐targeted interventions and prioritization of stable genetic variants for breeding mastitis‐resistant cattle.
papers.abstract_zh: 牛乳房炎是一種異質性發炎疾病，會危害產乳量、動物福祉及乳業永續性。儘管已有廣泛的轉錄體學與表觀基因體學研究，截至 2026 年 9 月完成的 PubMed 檢索顯示，僅有 12 項探討牛乳房炎表觀轉錄體調控的原創研究，約佔索引文獻的 0.1%。本篇綜論批判性地評估了 $N^6$-甲基腺苷（$m^6A$）——牛乳房炎中研究最廣泛的 RNA 修飾、其調控機制及對乳房免疫的影響，同時將 $m^5C$ 及 A-to-I 編輯界定為機制研究的優先方向。現有證據顯示，轉錄本特異性 RNA 穩定性是獲得最多支持的機制，並為探討 $m^6A$ 依賴性轉譯奠定了基礎。ALKBH5–LOC4191、YTHDF2–IER3、YTHDF2 相關的 CCL20 與 CCL5 調控、$m^6A$ 調控的 LncRNA7825 以及 FTO–FN1 的功能研究表明，$m^6A$ 會重塑發炎訊息傳遞、粒線體壓力、上皮屏障完整性、細胞存活與細菌控制。綜合這些發現，我們提出了「情境依賴的 RNA 命運檢查點模型」，在此模型中，生物學效應取決於受修飾的轉錄本、效應蛋白、病原體、細胞情境及感染階段。FTO–FN1 軸顯示細菌控制與組織保護可能會分歧，確立了它們作為互補結果的地位。未來研究應利用時間解析多體學、核苷酸特異性擾動、原代細胞、乳房類器官及縱向牛隻樣本，來檢驗 $m^6A$ 是否提供早期的轉錄後反應層級，以及病原體是否对其进行操控。非 $m^6A$ 修飾的平行分析應能界定相互作用的調控層級。這些方法應當確立具因果關係的修飾位點、解析病原體特異性調控、將分子機制與疾病病程相連結，並支援經過驗證的乳汁生物標記、標靶乳房的介入措施，以及優先選育具抗乳房炎特性牛隻的穩定遺傳變異。

papers.title: Genomic characterisation and lytic potential of phage SF01 against multidrug-resistant Salmonella enterica subsp. enterica , a key agent of infection in poultry
papers.abstract: 1. Salmonella enterica remains the key cause of salmonellosis in poultry, causing high morbidity and mortality. Due to the unprecedented resistance of S. enterica to antibiotics, bacteriophages have emerged as a powerful alternative to conventional antibiotics treatment for salmonellosis.2. In this study, a strain was isolated from infected broiler chickens and whole-genome sequencing (WGS) identified the strain SFD-01 as S. enterica subsp. enterica. Bioinformatics analyses revealed that the genome was 4.6 Mb in size with 4559 coding sequences (CDS), 77 tRNAs and 4 rRNAs. Additionally, 119 virulence genes, 125 antimicrobial resistance genes, 5 mobile genetic elements, 2 prophages and multiple copies of pathogenicity islands (SPI) were identified in the genome.3. To address this, bacteriophage SF01 was isolated from wastewater near a chicken slaughterhouse against host strain SFD-01. Transmission electron microscopy revealed that the phage had an 85-nm icosahedral head and a 130-nm long contractile tail. The Felixounavirus SF01 exhibited high stability across pH 3–9. Phage lytic activity at a multiplicity of infection of 0.01 restricted the bacterial growth.4. Whole genome analysis (WGS) identified phage SF01 as a Felixounavirus with 88-kb genome composed of 174 CDS, 20 tRNA genes and with no lysogenic markers, resistance genes or virulence factors. The strict lytic potential of phage SF01 makes it a highly viable option for use in the potential biocontrol of the novel strain S. enterica subsp. enterica serotype 42:z4,z23.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 腸道沙門氏菌（Salmonella enterica）仍然之家禽沙門氏菌症的主要病因，會造成高罹病率與高死亡率。由於腸道沙門氏菌對抗生素產生前所未有的抗藥性，噬菌體已成為替代傳統抗生素治療沙門氏菌症的有力選擇。

2. 在本研究中，從受感染的肉雞中分離出一株菌株，經全基因串接定序（WGS）鑑定該SFD-01菌株為腸道沙門氏菌腸道亞種（S. enterica subsp. enterica）。生物資訊學分析顯示，其基因體大小為 4.6 Mb，具有 4559 個編碼序列（CDS）、77 個 tRNA 及 4 個 rRNA。此外，在該基因體中鑑定出 119 個毒力基因、125 個抗生素抗藥性基因、5 個移動性遺傳元件、2 個前噬菌體以及多個致病島（SPI）複本。

3. 為了解決此問題，從雞隻屠宰場附近的廢水中分離出針對宿主菌株 SFD-01 的噬菌體 SF01。穿透式電子顯微鏡顯示，該噬菌體具有一個 85 奈米的二十面體頭部以及一個 130 奈米長的收縮性尾部。菲利克斯奧微病毒屬（Felixounavirus）的 SF01 在 pH 3–9 之間展現出高度穩定性。在感染多重性（MOI）為 0.01 時，噬菌體的裂解活性可抑制細菌生長。

4. 全基因體分析（WGS）鑑定噬菌體 SF01 為菲利克斯奧微病毒屬（Felixounavirus），其 88-kb 的基因體由 174 個 CDS、20 個 tRNA 基因所組成，且不具溶原性標記、抗藥性基因或毒力因子。噬菌體 SF01 嚴格的裂解潛力，使其成為具備潛力應用於生物防治新型腸道沙門氏菌腸道亞種血清型 42:z4,z23 的高度可行選項。

papers.title: Dietary vitamin C improves reproductive performance by increasing antioxidant capacity, steroid hormone concentration and expression of genes involved in steroid hormone synthesis in Yangzhou geese
papers.abstract: 1. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of dietary ascorbic acid (vitamin C) supplementation on the reproductive performance, follicular development, antioxidant capacity, serum steroid hormone concentration and expression of genes involved in steroid hormone synthesis in Yangzhou geese.2. A total of 540, 221-day-old geese (450 females and 90 males) were randomly divided into five groups that received different diets. Treatments included vitamin C levels of 0, 100, 200, 300 or 400 mg/kg, respectively.3. Dietary vitamin C supplementation led to a highly significant linear increase in laying rate (p < 0.01), with significant improvements detected at 300 mg/kg and 400 mg/kg (p < 0.01). Thus, within the supplement range of 0–400 mg/kg, graded additions of vitamin C linearly improved reproductive performance with economic benefits. In consideration of commercial breeding practices together with the observed physiological and productive indices, dietary vitamin C supplementation at 300 mg/kg was effective.4. Feeding 300 mg/kg prompted oestradiol and progesterone concentrations in both serum and hierarchical follicular yolks (p < 0.05) and the number of primordial follicles increased significantly (p < 0.01). This level of vitamin C in the feed resulted in elevated activity levels of total antioxidant capacity, superoxide dismutase and catalase in both serum and follicles, along with a reduction in malondialdehyde levels.5. Dietary supplementation with 300 mg/kg vitamin C increased the expressions of StAR, HSD3B1 and CYP11A1 in granulosa layer. Similar expression patterns of CYP17A1, CYP19A1, HSD3B1 and HSD17B1 were detected in the theca layer.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 本研究旨在評估日糧中補充抗壞血酸（維生素C）對揚州鵝繁殖性能、卵泡發育、抗氧化能力、血清類固醇激素濃度及類固醇激素合成相關基因表現之影響。
2. 試驗選取 540 隻 221 日齡之揚州鵝（公鵝 90 隻、母鵝 450 隻），隨機分為五組並飼喂不同日糧。處理組之維生素C添加量分別為 0、100、200、300 及 400 mg/kg。
3. 日糧補充維生素C使產蛋率呈極顯著的線性增加（p < 0.01），且在添加 300 mg/kg 和 400 mg/kg 時檢測到顯著改善（p < 0.01）。因此，在 0–400 mg/kg 的補充範圍內，分級添加維生素C能以具經濟效益的方式線性改善繁殖性能。綜合商業育種實務以及觀察到的生理與生產指標，日糧補充 300 mg/kg 的維生素C效果最佳。
4. 飼喂 300 mg/kg 可促進血清及級別卵泡卵黃中的雌二醇與黃體素濃度（p < 0.05），且原始卵泡數量顯著增加（p < 0.01）。此飼料維生素C水平使血清及卵泡中的總抗氧化能力、超氧化物歧化酶和過氧化氫酶活性水平升高，同時降低丙二醛水平。
5. 日糧補充 300 mg/kg 維生素C提高了顆粒層中 StAR、HSD3B1 和 CYP11A1 的表現量。在膜層中也檢測到 CYP17A1、CYP19A1、HSD3B1 和 HSD17B1 具有相似的表現模式。

papers.title: Serum Corticosterone Concentrations and Granulocyte-to-Lymphocyte Ratios in Slaughter Geese Across Transport-Distance Categories: An Exploratory Descriptive Field Study
papers.abstract: Transport exposes poultry to multiple stressors. The declining number of slaughterhouses in the European Union can increase transport distances to slaughter facilities. Transport-related stress responses are documented in chickens and ducks but remain poorly characterized in geese. This exploratory descriptive field study characterized serum corticosterone (CORT) concentrations and the granulocyte-to-lymphocyte (G/L) ratio in pooled blood samples representing 292 slaughter geese from six flocks: one non-transported flock slaughtered on a farm and five commercial flocks transported 1–100, 101–200, 201–300, 301–400, or >400 km. Exploratory pool-level comparisons indicated overall differences in G/L ratios among the five evaluable flocks (p = 0.035), but no pairwise difference remained significant after Bonferroni adjustment. Corticosterone was lower in pooled serum samples from the non-transported flock than in those from the 1–100, 201–300, and >400 km flocks (p < 0.001). However, one flock and one journey per distance category prevented separation of distance effects from flock-, farm-, age- or journey-specific influences. These observations provide important descriptive field data but do not permit conclusions about an independent effect of transport distance. Studies with multiple independent flocks and journeys per distance category are required.
papers.abstract_zh: 運輸會使家禽面臨多種壓力源。歐盟屠宰場數量的減少可能會增加前往屠宰設施的運輸距離。與運輸相關的壓力反應在雞和鴨身上已有記錄，但在鵝身上則尚未得到充分的描述。這項探索性描述性現場研究描述了代表來自六個鵝群共 292 隻屠宰鵝之混合血液樣本中的血清皮質酮（CORT）濃度與嗜顆粒球與淋巴細胞比值（G/L 比值）：一個在農場屠宰的未運輸鵝群，以及五個分別運輸 1–100、101–200、201–300、301–400 或 >400 公里的商業鵝群。探索性的混合樣本層級比較顯示，五個可評估鵝群之間的 G/L 比值存在整體差異（p = 0.035），但在進行邦ferroni（Bonferroni）校正後，沒有任何成對差異達到顯著水準。未運輸鵝群混合血清樣本中的皮質酮低於 1–100、201–300 和 >400 公里鵝群的樣本（p < 0.001）。然而，每個距離類別僅有一個鵝群和一次運輸，使我們無法將距離效應與鵝群、農場、年齡或運輸特異性影響區分開來。這些觀察結果提供了重要的描述性現場數據，但無法得出關於運輸距離之獨立效應的結論。未來需要針對每個距離類別納入多個獨立鵝群和運輸次數的研究。

papers.title: Characterizing Runs of Homozygosity and Inbreeding in American Mink Using SNP Data and Pedigree Information
papers.abstract: Inbreeding increases the likelihood of deleterious recessive alleles becoming homozygous and consequently affecting economically important traits. Runs of homozygosity (ROH), the continuous homozygous segments of the genome and the higher than expected homozygosity (HOM) are genomic indicators of inbreeding, quantified as F ROH and F HOM , respectively. Previous ROH analyses in American mink ( Neogale vison ) were restricted to scaffold‐level references and could not resolve long autozygous segments. In this study, we characterized ROH in 1413 mink genotyped with the Affymetrix Mink 70K panel (50,902 autosomal SNPs after quality control) on the chromosome‐level genome assembly and compared F ROH with F HOM and with pedigree‐based inbreeding (F PED ) derived from 24,633 pedigree records. ROH were detected in all individuals, with a mean of 149.61 ± 13.82 segments per individual. Segments longer than 8 Mb, not detectable in earlier studies of this population, represented 12.86% of all ROH and accounted for 0.10 of the mean F ROH of 0.28. Mean F HOM and F PED were −0.03 and 0.02, respectively. ROH were unevenly distributed across chromosomes and chromosomes 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 and 11 harboured 78.59% of all segments. The Pearson correlation coefficient was highest (0.72) between F ROH and F HOM and moderate (0.34) between genomic inbreeding and F PED , increasing with ROH length to 0.35 for segments longer than 16 Mb. Because the density of the marker panel limits the resolution of short segments, quantitative inference was restricted to ROH longer than 4 Mb. Our results indicate that recent autozygosity in this closed population is concentrated in a small number of long genomic segments, providing an opportunity to inform mating decisions.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics
papers.abstract_zh: 近親交配會增加有害隱性等立基因成為純合子的機率，進而影響具經濟重要性的性狀。純合連續片段（runs of homozygosity, ROH）是基因體中連續的純合片段，而高於預期的純合度（homozygosity, HOM）則是近親交配的基因體指標，分別以 $F_{ROH}$ 與 $F_{HOM}$ 來量化。先前對美洲水貂（*Neogale vison*）的 ROH 分析受限於鷹架層級（scaffold-level）的參考基因體，無法解析長型的同源接合（autozygous）片段。在本研究中，我們使用基於染色體層級基因體組裝的 Affymetrix 水貂 70K 晶片（經品質控制後包含 50,902 個體染色體 SNP），對 1,413 隻水貂的 ROH 進行了特性分析，並將 $F_{ROH}$ 與 $F_{HOM}$ 以及源自 24,633 筆譜系紀錄的譜系近親交配係數（$F_{PED}$）進行比較。所有個體均偵測到 ROH，平均每個個體有 $149.61 \pm 13.82$ 個片段。長於 8 Mb 的片段（在該族群先前的研究中無法被偵測）佔所有 ROH 的 $12.86\%$，並佔平均 $F_{ROH}$（0.28）中的 0.10。平均 $F_{HOM}$ 與 $F_{PED}$ 分別為 -0.03 與 0.02。ROH 在染色體上的分布不均，其中第 1、2、3、4、6 和 11 號染色體包含了所有片段的 $78.59\%$。$F_{ROH}$ 與 $F_{HOM}$ 之間的皮爾森相關係數最高（0.72），基因體近親交配與 $F_{PED}$ 之間則呈中等相關（0.34），且隨著 ROH 長度增加而上升，對於長於 16 Mb 的片段其相關係數可達 0.35。由於標記晶片的密度限制了短片段的解析度，因此數量推論僅限於長於 4 Mb 的 ROH。我們的結果顯示，這個封閉族群近期的同源接合現象集中於少數幾個長基因體片段中，這為指導交配決策提供了契機。

papers.title: Early-life microbial contact with adult hens modulates cecal microbiota and mitigates host responses to lipopolysaccharide-induced stress in broilers
papers.abstract: Background In commercial production, the absence of adult hens disrupts natural gut colonization, forcing chicks to rely on environmental microbes and potentially compromising the ecological succession essential for health. This study investigated whether early-life adult hen microbial contact could optimize the intestinal community and metabolite profiles, thereby mitigating lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced immunological stress in broilers. Accordingly, 128 one-day-old broilers were assigned to control or adult hen microbial contact groups. Hens were removed on D 10, and LPS was administered on D 18 and D 20, resulting in a 2 × 2 factorial design. Results Adult hen microbial contact did not affect body weight or ileal histomorphology on D 10 or D 21. However, it reshaped the alpha diversity ( P < 0.05) and beta diversity ( P < 0.05) of the cecal microbiota, enriching beneficial genera such as Bacteroides , Prevotellaceae , Rikenellaceae , Muribaculaceae , and Megasphaera , although these were not primarily established through direct adult hen transfer. These microbial alterations were accompanied by increased production of cecal volatile fatty acids ( P < 0.05) and altered tryptophan metabolism ( P < 0.05), characterized by the conversion of serum tryptophan to indoleacetic acid. In the ileum, the adult hen microbial contact upregulated ( P < 0.05) genes associated with mucosal barrier integrity ( MUC13 , CLDN2 ) and antioxidant defense ( SOD2 , FOXO1 ), while independently downregulating ( P < 0.05) hepatic genes involved in redox regulation and autophagy ( GRX5 , LC3-1 ). LPS challenge induced a pronounced ( P < 0.05) antioxidant imbalance in the ileum, characterized by the downregulation of CAT and NRF2 , together with elevated expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines ( IL8 , IFNA , TNFA ), compromising barrier function ( MUC13 , CLDN2 ). Concurrently, the LPS challenge increased ( P < 0.05) the expression of hepatic genes involved in redox regulation and autophagy ( GRX5 , LC3-1 ), consistent with a systemic stress response. Notably, microbial contact attenuated the LPS-induced reduction in valeric acid ( P < 0.05), suggesting a protective effect on microbial metabolite production under immunological stress. Conclusion Adult hen microbial contact did not improve growth performance or ileal histomorphology, but shaped the early-life gut microbiota and associated metabolite profiles, contributing to improved resilience to subsequent immune challenges in broilers.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：在商業化生產中，成年母雞的缺失會打亂自然的腸道定殖，迫使雛雞依賴環境微生物，進而可能危害對健康至關重要的生態演替。本研究旨在探討早期接觸成年母雞微生物是否能優化腸道菌相與代謝物譜，從而減輕脂多醣（LPS）誘導的肉雞免疫壓力。因此，將 128 隻一日齡肉雞分派至對照組或成年母雞微生物接觸組。母雞於第 10 天移出，並於第 18 天和第 20 天注射 LPS，形成 2 × 2 因子設計。結果：成年母雞微生物接觸對第 10 天或第 21 天的體重或迴腸組織形態無顯著影響。然而，它重塑了盲腸微生物相的阿伐多樣性（$\text{P} < 0.05$）與貝塔多樣性（$\text{P} < 0.05$），豐富了諸如擬桿菌屬（*Bacteroides*）、普雷沃菌科（*Prevotellaceae*）、理研菌科（*Rikenellaceae*）、毛螺菌科相關屬（*Muribaculaceae*）和巨球型菌屬（*Megasphaera*）等有益屬，儘管這些菌群主要並非透過成年母雞的直接轉移而建立。這些微生物的改變伴隨著盲腸揮發性脂肪酸產量的增加（$\text{P} < 0.05$）以及色胺酸代謝的改變（$\text{P} < 0.05$），其特徵為血清色胺酸轉化為吲哚乙酸。在迴腸中，成年母雞微生物接觸上調了（$\text{P} < 0.05$）與黏膜屏障完整性（*MUC13*、*CLDN2*）和抗氧化防禦（*SOD2*、*FOXO1*）相關的基因，同時獨立地下調了（$\text{P} < 0.05$）參與氧化還原調節與自噬的肝臟基因（*GRX5*、*LC3-1*）。LPS 攻擊導致迴腸產生顯著的（$\text{P} < 0.05$）抗氧化失衡，其特徵為 *CAT* 和 *Nrf2* 的下調，以及促發炎細胞激素（*IL8*、*IFNA*、*TNFA*）表達的升高，進而損害屏障功能（*MUC13*、*CLDN2*）。同時，LPS 攻擊增加了（$\text{P} < 0.05$）參與氧化還原調節與自噬的肝臟基因（*GRX5*、*LC3-1*）之表達，這與全身性壓力反應一致。值得注意的是，微生物接觸減輕了 LPS 引起的戊酸降低（$\text{P} < 0.05$），這表明其對免疫壓力下微生物代謝物的產生物理保護作用。結論：成年母雞微生物接觸雖未改善生長性能或迴腸組織形態，但塑造了早期腸道微生物相及相關的代謝物譜，有助於提高肉雞對後續免疫挑戰的抵禦能力。

papers.title: Detection and Persistence of Human Semen and DNA on Animal Fur: Implications for Forensic Investigation of Animal Sexual Abuse
papers.abstract: Animal sexual abuse (ASA) involves the sexual molestation of animals by humans. Forensic DNA analysis of human biological fluids on animal fur may provide investigative leads to a potential suspect. This study was the first to longitudinally assess the recovery of human semen and DNA from three fur models: freshly dissected baboon fur, preserved antelope hides and faux fur. Daily swabbing consistently demonstrated that DNA profiles could be generated from semen over the 14-day study period. Samples in baboon fur typically had greater degradation and yielded lower DNA concentrations compared to other fur models investigated. Although the baboon model best represented a deceased animal, experiments beyond 14 days were limited by decomposition. This study highlights the challenge of selecting a suitable fur model and demonstrates that model choice may influence DNA retention over time. Future research should consider models representing living animals and investigate dynamic variables (e.g., movement, body heat) on semen and DNA retention on animal fur. Overall, this study provides proof of concept and constitutes the first baseline data pertaining to evidence retention in the context of ASA. These findings support the application of forensic molecular techniques in ASA investigations.
papers.abstract_zh: 動物性虐待（Animal sexual abuse, ASA）涉及人類對動物的性侵犯。對動物毛皮上的人類生物體液進行法醫DNA分析，可為潛在嫌疑人提供偵查線索。本研究首次採縱向評估，自三種毛皮模型中回收人類精液與DNA：新鮮解剖的狒狒毛皮、保存的羚羊皮以及人造毛皮。每日的拭子採樣持續顯示，在為期14天的研究期間內，皆可自精液取得DNA圖譜。與其他研究的毛皮模型相比，狒狒毛皮中的樣本通常降解較嚴重且產出較低的DNA濃度。儘管狒狒模型最能代表死亡動物，但超過14天的實驗受到腐敗過程的限制。本研究凸顯了選擇合適毛皮模型的挑戰，並證明模型的選擇可能會影響DNA隨時間的保存。未來研究應考慮代表活體動物的模型，並探討動態變數（例如運動、體溫）對動物毛皮上精液與DNA保存的影響。總體而言，本研究提供了概念驗證，並構成了首批與ASA情境下證據保存相關的基準數據。這些發現支持法醫分子技術在ASA調查中的應用。

papers.title: Effects of Bacillus licheniformis Supplementation on Laying Performance, Antioxidant Capacity, and Cecal Microbiota in Post-Peak Laying Hens
papers.abstract: Bacillus licheniformis, a multifunctional probiotic, improves performance in peak laying hens, but its effects during post-peak laying—characterized by declining ovarian function, impaired intestinal barrier, and oxidative stress—remain unclear. This study evaluated the effects of dietary B. licheniformis on laying performance, antioxidant and immune parameters, intestinal morphology, cecal microbiota, and fermentation metabolites in post-peak-phase laying hens. A total of 720 forty-three-week-old laying hens were randomly assigned to four treatments: a basal diet or the basal diet supplemented with B. licheniformis at 2.5 × 109, 5 × 109, or 1 × 1010 CFU/kg for 31 days. Supplementation at 5 × 109 CFU/kg consistently improved the laying rate from 78.96 ± 0.47% to 80.40 ± 0.64% (+1.44 percentage points, p = 0.0091) and decreased the feed-to-egg ratio from 2.53 ± 0.02 to 2.47 ± 0.02 (−2.4 percentage points, p = 0.005). It enhanced systemic antioxidant capacity, as indicated by a decrease in serum MDA (35.8% p = 0.002) and increases in GSH-Px (33.2%, p = 0.002) and SOD (56.0%, p = 0.011). Jejunal and ileal villus height and villus-to-crypt ratio were also increased (p < 0.05). Cecal microbiota shifted toward a higher relative abundance of Clostridia_UCG-014 (p = 0.006) and norank_o_RF39 (p = 0.017) and a lower abundance of Megasphaera (p = 0.009), whereas individual and total VFA concentrations did not differ among groups (p > 0.05). In conclusion, 5 × 109 CFU/kg B. licheniformis exerted the most consistent benefits in post-peak-phase laying hens, likely through the modulation of gut microbiota, intestinal barrier integrity, and antioxidant status. These findings support B. licheniformis as a promising probiotic for sustainable laying-hen production.
papers.abstract_zh: 地衣芽孢桿菌（Bacillus licheniformis）是一種多功能益生菌，能改善產蛋高峰期產蛋雞的生產性能，但其對產蛋高峰期後（以卵巢功能下降、腸道屏障受損及氧化壓力為特徵）產蛋雞的效果仍不清楚。本研究旨在評估飼糧中添加地衣芽孢桿菌對產蛋高峰期後產蛋雞之產蛋性能、抗氧化與免疫參數、腸道形態、盲腸微生物相及發酵代謝產物的影響。試驗選用 720 隻 43 週齡產蛋雞，隨機分為四個處理組：基礎飼糧組，以及基礎飼糧分別添加 2.5 × 10⁹、5 × 10⁹ 或 1 × 10¹⁰ CFU/kg 地衣芽孢桿菌，試驗期為 31 天。結果顯示，添加 5 × 10⁹ CFU/kg 的地衣芽孢桿菌可持續提升產蛋率，從 78.96 ± 0.47% 增加至 80.40 ± 0.64%（+1.44 個百分點，p = 0.0091），並降低料蛋比，從 2.53 ± 0.02 降至 2.47 ± 0.02（−2.4 個百分點，p = 0.005）。此添加量亦增強了全身抗氧化能力，表現為血清丙二醛（MDA）降低（35.8%，p = 0.002），以及麩胱甘肽過氧化酶（GSH-Px，33.2%，p = 0.002）與超氧化物歧化酶（SOD，56.0%，p = 0.011）活性增加。空腸與迴腸的絨毛高度及絨毛高度與隱窩深度比值亦顯著增加（p < 0.05）。在盲腸微生物相方面，Clostridia_UCG-014（p = 0.006）和 norank_o_RF39（p = 0.017）的相對豐度增加，而巨球形菌屬（Megasphaera）的豐度降低（p = 0.009），各組間的個別及總揮發性脂肪酸（VFA）濃度則無顯著差異（p > 0.05）。綜上所述，添加 5 × 10⁹ CFU/kg 的地衣芽孢桿菌對產蛋高峰期後產蛋雞產生最顯著且一致的益處，這可能透過調節腸道微生物相、腸道屏障完整性及抗氧化狀態來實現。這些結果支持地作為促進蛋雞永續生產之潛力益生菌。

papers.title: Greenhouse Gas Emissions from Large-Scale Dairy Farms: Interannual Dynamics, Farm-Level Heterogeneity, and Key Determinants
papers.abstract: The transition to low-emission (LE) dairy production is essential for mitigating agricultural greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. However, the interannual variability and principal drivers of farm-level GHG footprints across intensive dairy farms remain insufficiently characterized, constraining targeted mitigation strategies. This study aimed to (i) quantify interannual variation in on-farm GHG emission intensity, (ii) characterize management contrasts between high- and low-emission farms, (iii) clarify the underlying mechanisms, and (iv) identify optimization pathways. A supplementary sensitivity analysis encompassing upstream emissions associated with feed production was performed using an expanded system boundary to assess the effects of system boundary selection on the estimated GHG emissions. Using 3-year (2021–2023) field data from 22 intensive dairy farms, a standardized farm-level GHG inventory was used to quantify operational GHG emission intensity per unit of fat- and protein-corrected milk (FPCM). The production-weighted mean on-farm operational GHG intensity was 0.86 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM, with enteric methane constituting the dominant emission source. Incorporating upstream emissions associated with feed production contributed an additional 0.427 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM, yielding a total emission intensity of 1.287 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM under the expanded system boundary, representing a 49.7% increase relative to the operational inventory. Feed upstream emissions accounted for 33.2% of the total emissions estimated within the expanded system boundary. Both herd size and energy consumption exhibited increasing trends throughout the study period, whereas the proportion of lactating cows relating to the total herd declined from 46.01% in 2021 to 44.32% in 2023, suggesting that the expansion of the overall herd exceeded the corresponding growth in the lactating cow population. Under the operational system boundary, high-emission (HE) farms exhibited relatively greater contributions to their GHG emission profiles from enteric methane production, electricity consumption, and manure management activities. Conversely, LE farms attained improved performance through higher proportions of lactating cows, greater feed efficiency, and manure anaerobic digestion. Correlation analysis linked herd size, energy consumption, and dry matter intake positively to on-farm GHG emissions. Dietary starch was associated with manure N2O emissions, while feed efficiency was associated with higher energy-related GHG emissions. Overall, herd composition, feeding management practices, energy utilization, and manure management strategies were identified as principal determinants of on-farm GHG emission performance. Furthermore, the sensitivity analysis employing an expanded system boundary demonstrated that incorporating upstream emissions associated with feed production substantially elevates the overall GHG emission intensity expressed per kg FPCM. This study helps address the lack of multi-year farm-level evidence for China’s dairy sector and proposes integrated strategies—herd structure adjustment, precision feeding, clean energy exploitation, and manure management—alongside sustained long-term monitoring, given the pronounced interannual variability. These findings highlight the roles of farm-level GHG inventories in identifying targeted on-farm emission mitigation opportunities and expanded system boundary assessments in quantifying the overall GHG burden associated with the entire dairy production supply chain.
papers.abstract_zh: 轉型至低碳排放（LE）乳牛生產對於減緩農業溫室氣體（GHG）排放至關重要。然而，集約化乳牛場在場級溫室氣體足跡上的年際變異與主要驅動因素仍未得到充分闡明，從而限制了針對性減緩策略的制定。本研究旨在 (i) 量化場內溫室氣體排放強度的年際變異，(ii) 探討高排放與低排放牧場之間的管理差異，(iii) 釐清其潛在機制，以及 (iv) 識別優化途徑。本研究透過擴展系統邊界，進行了一項包含飼料生產相關上游排放的補充敏感度分析，以評估系統邊界選擇對估算溫室氣體排放的影響。基於 22 個集約化乳牛場為期 3 年（2021–2023 年）的實地數據，利用標準化的場級溫室氣體盤查方法，量化了每單位乳脂與乳蛋白校正乳（FPCM）的營運性溫室氣體排放強度。產量加權的場內營運溫室氣體平均強度為 0.86 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM，其中腸道發酵產生的甲烷為主要的排放源。納入飼料生產相關的上游排放後，額外增加了 0.427 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM，在擴展系統邊界下總排放強度達到 1.287 kg CO2-eq kg−1 FPCM，相較於營運盤查增加了 49.7%。飼料上游排放佔擴展系統邊界下總估算排放量的 33.2%。在研究期間，牛群規模與能源消耗均呈上升趨勢，而泌乳牛佔總牛群的比例則從 2021 年的 46.01% 下降至 2023 年的 44.32%，這表明整體牛群的擴張速度超過了泌乳牛群的相應增長。在營運系統邊界下，高排放（HE）牧場在其溫室氣體排放結構中，來自腸道甲烷產生、電力消耗和糞尿管理的貢獻相對較高。相反地，低排放牧場透過提高泌乳牛比例、提高飼料效率以及採用糞尿厭氧消化技術，實現了更佳的環境表現。相關性分析表明，牛群規模、能源消耗和乾物質攝取量與場內溫室氣體排放呈正相關。日糧澱粉與糞尿 N2O 排放有關，而飼料效率則與較高的能源相關溫室氣體排放有關。總體而言，牛群組成、飼養管理實務、能源利用和糞尿管理策略被確定為影響場內溫室氣體排放表現的主要決定因素。此外，採用擴展系統邊界的敏感度分析表明，納入飼料生產相關的上游排放會顯著提高以每公斤 FPCM 計算的整體溫室氣體排放強度。本研究有助於填補中國乳業缺乏多年期場級實證數據的空白，並考慮到明顯的年際變異，提出了整合性策略——包括牛群結構調整、精準飼養、清潔能源開發以及糞尿管理，同時強調需進行持續的長期監測。這些研究結果突顯了場級溫室氣體盤查在識別場內針對性減排機會方面的作用，以及擴展系統邊界評估在量化與整個乳品生產供應鏈相關的整體溫室氣體負擔方面的重要性。

papers.title: Genomic architecture of non-nominal offspring risk in a simulated composite cattle breed
papers.abstract: Background Composite cattle breeds are designed to combine complementary attributes from different founder breeds while retaining part of the heterosis generated by crossbreeding. Brangus cattle are nominally defined as 5/8 Angus and 3/8 Brahman, but the same global breed composition can be produced by different genomic architectures. This distinction may be important because animals with the same Brahman ancestry proportion may differ in ancestry heterozygosity, homozygous ancestry composition and segregation behaviour when used as parents. The objective of this study was to use controlled simulations to evaluate whether genomic architecture affects the risk of producing offspring outside the nominal Brangus ancestry range. Results We simulated two alternative pathways to the same expected Brahman ancestry proportion of 0.375. Although both pathways produced similar mean Brahman ancestry, the direct pathway generated a broader ancestry distribution than the indirect pathway, with a higher proportion of individuals outside the nominal interval. After filtering candidate sires to the nominal interval, formation-pathway-dependent genomic architectures remained evident. In a mixed inter se mating analysis extended to 100 generations and three population-size scenarios, pathway-specific ancestry-state differences were progressively eroded and the standard deviation of Brahman ancestry proportion declined after an early maximum, but non-nominal frequencies remained non-negligible over the simulated time horizon. Family-level simulations showed that matings between nominal parents differed substantially in their probability of producing non-nominal daughters. This risk depended on both the distance between the expected family mean and the target ancestry and the block-weighted segregation potential of the parental genomes. An exploratory quasibinomial model supported positive associations between non-nominal risk and displacement from the target and high-variance parental block structures. Finally, a heuristic-assisted simulation-informed sire allocation strategy increased the proportion of nominal daughters relative to random sire allocation, with the greatest gains obtained from broader sire catalogues. Conclusions Nominal breed composition does not define a unique genomic state. In simulated Brangus cattle, animals that were equivalent in global ancestry could differ in genomic architecture and in the offspring ancestry distributions generated by specific matings. These results suggest that composite-breed management should consider not only the ancestry proportion of individual animals, but also the expected outcome of sire–dam pairs.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：複合肉牛品種旨在結合不同創始品種的互補特徵，同時保留雜交產生的部分雜種優勢。布蘭格斯牛（Brangus）的名義品種組成定義為 5/8 安格斯牛與 3/8 婆羅門牛，然而相同的整體品種組成可能由不同的基因體架構所產生。這項區別可能很重要，因為具有相同婆羅門牛血統比例的動物，在作為親本使用時，其血統雜合度、純合血統組成與分離行為可能會有所不同。本研究的目的在於利用控制模擬來評估基因體架構是否會影響產生超出名義布蘭格斯牛血統範圍後代之風險。結果：我們模擬了達到相同預期婆羅門牛血統比例 0.375 的兩種不同途徑。儘管這兩種途徑產生了相似的平均婆羅門牛血統，但直接途徑產生的血統分佈比間接途徑更廣，且落在名義區間之外的個體比例更高。在將候選種公牛篩選至名義區間後，取決於培育途徑的基因體架構仍然十分顯著。在延伸至 100 個世代及三種族群大小情境的混合自交分析中，特定途徑的血統狀態差異逐漸被抹平，且婆羅門牛血統比例標準差在達到早期最大值後下降，但在模擬的時間範圍內，非名義頻率仍然不可忽視。家族層級的模擬顯示，名義親本之間的交配在產生非名義後代母牛的機率上有顯著差異。此風險取決於預期家族平均值與目標血統之間的距離，以及親本基因體的區塊加權分離潛能。探索性擬二項式模型支持非名義風險與偏離目標及高變異親本區塊結構之間的正相關性。最後，與隨機分配種公牛相比，啟發式輔助的模擬資訊種公牛分配策略提高了名義後代母牛的比例，其中以較廣泛的種公牛目錄獲得的增幅最大。結論：名義品種組成並不能定義唯一的基因體狀態。在模擬的布蘭格斯牛中，整體血統相同的動物在基因體架構以及特定交配所產生的後代血統分佈上可能有所不同。這些結果表明，複合品種的管理不僅應考慮個體動物的血統比例，還應考慮公母牛配對的預期結果。

papers.title: Determination and Prediction of Standardized Mineral Availabilities in Different Sources of Soybean Meals for Broilers
papers.abstract: This study was conducted to estimate the standardized mineral availabilities (SMAs) of 10 soybean meals (SBMs) fed to broilers, and prediction models were developed and validated based on chemical properties. A total of 308 broilers (22 d of age), having similar initial body weights, were assigned at random to 11 dietary groups, with 7 replicate cages per group and 4 broilers per cage. On d 26, the broilers were given 4 h access to either a mineral-free diet or 10 test SBM-formulated diets. Fecal collection then proceeded for 52 h for SMA measurement. SMA-prediction models were established via stepwise regression using data from 9 SBMs, with the remaining SBM randomly used to validate the models’ accuracy. Soybean meal source influenced (p < 0.02) SMAs in broilers. Manganese (Mn) exhibited the lowest standardized availability (SA) at 30.4%, whereas calcium (Ca) showed the highest SA at 66.2%. Six prediction models for SAs of potassium (K), Ca, phosphorus (P), zinc (Zn), Mn, and copper (Cu) in SBMs for broilers were developed from the chemical properties, exhibiting R2 values spanning 0.487 to 0.964 (p < 0.04). The prediction model for standardized Ca availability provided the best goodness-of-fit (R2 = 0.964, p < 0.001). By contrast, this model for standardized Cu availability performed the worst (R2 = 0.487, p = 0.037). Except for Zn and Mn, the predicted SAs for Ca, P, K, and Cu were generally consistent with the measured values. Taken together, the constructed prediction models in our work can serve as a reliable tool for quickly predicting the SAs of Ca, P, K, and Cu in SBMs for broilers.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在評估肉雞餵食 10 種大豆粕（SBM）之標準化礦物質可用率（SMAs），並基於化學特性建立與驗證預測模式。總共 308 隻初始體重相近的肉雞（22 日齡）被隨機分配至 11 個飲食組，每組 7 個重複籠，每籠 4 隻肉雞。在 26 日齡時，肉雞限時 4 小時攝食無礦物質飼糧或 10 種試驗大豆粕配製飼糧。隨後進行 52 小時的糞便收集以測定 SMA。利用其中 9 種大豆粕的數據透過逐步迴歸建立 SMA 預測模式，剩餘的 10 分之 1 大豆粕則隨機用於驗證模式的準確性。大豆粕來源會影響肉雞的 SMA（p < 0.02）。錳（Mn）的標準化可用率（SA）最低，為 30.4%，而鈣（Ca）的 SA 最高，為 66.2%。本研究根據化學特性建立了肉雞大豆粕中鉀（K）、鈣、磷（P）、鋅（Zn）、錳和銅（Cu）等 6 種 SA 的預測模式，其 $R^2$ 值介於 0.487 至 0.964 之間（p < 0.04）。標準化鈣可用率的預測模式具有最佳的配適度（$R^2 = 0.964$，p < 0.001）。相對地，標準化銅可用率的預測模式表現最差（$R^2 = 0.487$，p = 0.037）。除鋅和錳外，鈣、磷、鉀和銅的預測 SA 與實測值大致一致。綜上所述，本研究中所建構的預測模式可作為快速預測肉雞大豆粕中鈣、磷、鉀和銅之 SA 的可靠工具。

papers.title: A Nelore Cattle Structural Variant Catalog
papers.abstract: Structural variants (SVs) contribute more nucleotide divergence between mammalian genomes than single nucleotide polymorphisms, yet no population‐scale, long‐read‐validated SV catalog has been available for Bos indicus cattle. Nelore, the most numerically important indicine breed worldwide, diverges substantially from the taurine‐derived reference genome used for most bovine SV discovery, leaving its structural variation largely uncharacterized. Long‐read sequencing of 20 Nelore bulls with two complementary callers (Sniffles2, SVIM) yielded 82 581 dual‐caller concordant SVs, of which 74 222 insertions and deletions passed independent read‐based validation. Ensembl VEP annotation identified 561 HIGH‐impact variants (0.75% of the catalog) across 7040 protein‐coding genes. Only 22 894 SVs (30.7%), including 147 of 561 HIGH‐impact variants (26.2%), could be tagged by an existing BovineHD SNP ( r 2 ≥ 0.8), showing that routine array genotyping captures a minority of this variation. Intersection with an indicine‐ancestry SNP map identified 6114 SVs (8.2%) enriched in Bos indicus , including 61 HIGH‐impact variants overlapping genes with plausible roles in immune/inflammatory defense and oxidative‐stress response, providing a resource and candidate variant set for genomic selection and tropical‐adaptation studies in indicine cattle.
papers.abstract_zh: 相較於單核苷酸多型性，結構變異（SVs）對哺乳動物基因組間的核苷酸差異貢獻更大，然而過去一直缺乏針對印度牛（Bos indicus）的群體規模、長讀長驗證之結構變異目錄。內羅爾牛（Nelore）是全球數量最重要的印度牛品種，與多數牛隻結構變異發現所使用的牛屬參考基因組（源自歐亞牛）存在顯著分化，導致其結構變異在很大程度上仍未被充分解析。本研究對20頭內羅爾公牛進行長讀長定序，並結合兩種互補的呼叫軟體（Sniffles2、SVIM），共得出82,581個雙軟體一致的結構變異，其中74,222個插入與刪除通過了獨立的基於讀長的驗證。Ensembl VEP註釋在7,040個蛋白質編碼基因中識別出561個高影響（HIGH-impact）變異（佔目錄的0.75%）。僅有22,894個結構變異（30.7%）——包含561個高影響變異中的147個（26.2%）——可被現有的BovineHD SNP晶片標記（$r^2 \ge 0.8$），顯示常規晶片基因型分型僅能捕捉此類變異的一小部分。透過與印度牛祖先成分SNP圖譜交集，識別出6114個在印度牛中顯著富集的結構變異（8.2%），其中包括61個高影響變異，這些變異與在免疫/發炎防禦及氧化壓力反應中具有合理功能的基因重疊，為印度牛的基因體選育與熱帶適應研究提供了資源與候選變異集。

papers.title: A Comparison of Conventional Lighting Versus Poultry-Specific Lighting During the Day in Combination With or Without a Blue Light “Moonphase” at Night
papers.abstract: Lighting is a key environmental factor influencing the welfare and productivity of laying hens; however, the combined effects of poultry-specific daytime spectra and dim blue “moonlight” during the scotoperiod remain poorly characterized. This study aimed to evaluate the effects of spectral modification of daytime lighting and the use of dim monochromatic blue light at night on stress, fear, leg health, egg production, egg quality, and feeding activity in aged laying hens. One hundred and twenty 70-wk-old laying hens were assigned to one of four lighting treatments, arranged as a 2 × 2 factorial of daytime spectrum × night-time condition, for 28 d following a 14-d acclimation under common lighting: conventional 3000 K white LEDs (CON); poultry-specific lighting (PSL) combining 3000 K white LEDs with 630 nm red light; CON with dim monochromatic blue light at night (CON-moon); and PSL with dim monochromatic blue light at night (PSL-moon). Plasma corticosterone, heterophil-to-lymphocyte (H/L) ratio, composite asymmetry, tonic immobility, inversion response, tibial breaking strength and bone ash, egg production, egg quality, and AI-quantified feeding activity were measured. By the end of the treatment period, hens under PSL had lower corticosterone concentrations, lower H/L ratios, and less physical asymmetry than hens under conventional light, together with taller albumen and higher Haugh unit values, and they spent less time at the feeder without eating less. Moonlight at night produced a further reduction in the stress indicators and, by the final sampling, heavier eggs with stronger shells. Hen-day egg production and tibial breaking strength were unaffected by lighting. These findings indicate that poultry-specific lighting paired with dim blue moonlight is a practical, noninvasive enrichment strategy that can simultaneously improve welfare and egg quality without compromising production.
papers.abstract_zh: 光照是影響產蛋雞福祉與生產效能的關鍵環境因素；然而，家禽專屬的日間光譜與暗期中微弱藍光「月光」的綜合效應，目前仍少有明確的研究。本研究旨在評估日間光譜調整與夜間使用微弱單色藍光對高齡產蛋雞之壓力、恐懼、腳部健康、產蛋率、雞蛋品質及攝食行為的影響。將一百二十隻 70 週齡產蛋雞隨機分配至四種光照處理中，採日間光譜 × 夜間條件之 2 × 2 因子設計，在共同光照下適應 14 天後進行為期 28 天的試驗：傳統 3000 K 白光 LED（CON）；結合 3000 K 白光 LED 與 630 nm 紅光的家禽專屬光照（PSL）；CON 搭配夜間微弱單色藍光（CON-moon）；以及 PSL 搭配夜間微弱單色藍光（PSL-moon）。本研究測定了血漿皮質酮、嗜異性球與淋巴球比值（H/L 比）、綜合不對稱性、強直性靜止、倒立反應、脛骨斷裂強度與骨灰分、產蛋率、雞蛋品質，以及透過人工智慧（AI）量化的攝食活動。試驗期結束時，與傳統光照相比，處於 PSL 下的產蛋雞具有較低的皮質酮濃度、較低的 H/L 比及較少的身體不對稱性，同時伴隨較高的蛋白高度與豪氏單位數，且牠們在飼槽停留的時間較短但攝食量並未減少。夜間的月光使壓力指標進一步降低，且在最後一次採樣時，產出了較重且蛋殼較強韌的雞蛋。產蛋率與脛骨斷裂強度則不受光照影響。這些研究結果顯示，家禽專屬光照搭配微弱藍光月光是一種實用且無創的環境豐富化策略，能在不影響生產效能的情況下，同時改善福祉與雞蛋品質。

papers.title: Mitogenome Insights Into the Domestication and Phylogeography of Zebu Cattle: A Focus on Pakistani Breeds and Asian Lineages
papers.abstract: Zebu cattle ( Bos indicus ) represent a critical livestock resource in the arid and semi‐arid regions, known for their disease resistance, heat tolerance and physiological hardiness. Despite their agricultural importance, the precise matrilineal evolutionary history, genetic diversity and demographic trajectory remain incompletely resolved within the broader context of South Asian cattle domestication. This study explores the phylogeographic patterns and maternal lineage diversity of zebu cattle through complete mitochondrial genomes (mtDNA), the D‐loop, and hypervariable regions from 50 individuals of 10 indigenous Pakistani breeds. These breeds were classified into three regions: North Pakistan, Central Pakistan/Punjab (Indus Valley region) and South Pakistan (the site of Mohenjo‐Daro). Our data include 183 newly generated sequences and are supplemented with comparative datasets from 19 countries. Analysis reveals South Pakistan, especially the Mehrgarh area, as a key potential domestication epicentre, exhibiting highest nucleotide diversity ( π = 0.01480) across Asian zebu populations, accompanied by ancient maternal lineages estimated to date back approximately 2.17 million years. Highest haplotype diversity was observed in Punjab (0.901 ± 0.014) followed by Southern Pakistan (0.893 ± 0.026). Phylogenetic and demographic analyses (mismatch distribution, Fu's Fs) further support an early dispersal scenario (I1 haplogroup) originating in Mehrgarh and radiating through the Indus Valley into broader Asian lineages. These findings enhance our understanding of the domestication origins of Bos indicus , its implications for breed conservation and sustainable livestock management.
papers.abstract_zh: 瘤牛（*Bos indicus*）是乾旱與半乾旱地區至關重要的家畜資源，以抗病能力、耐熱性及生理韌性聞名。儘管其具備重要的農業價值，但在南亞牛隻馴化的更廣泛背景下，其確切的母系演化歷史、遺傳多樣性與人口統計學軌跡仍未完全釐清。本研究透過來自巴基斯坦 10 個本土品種共 50 個體的完整粒線體基因組（mtDNA）、D 迴圈及高變異區，探討瘤牛的親緣地理模式與母系譜系多樣性。這些品種被歸類為三個區域：巴基斯坦北部、巴基斯坦中部／旁遮普（印度河流域地區）以及巴基斯坦南部（莫亨焦達羅遺址所在地）。我們的數據包含 183 個新產生的序列，並輔以來自 19 個國家的比較數據集。分析顯示，巴基斯坦南部（特別是梅爾加爾地區）是關鍵的潛在馴化中心，其展現出亞洲瘤牛族群中最高的核苷酸多樣性（$\pi = 0.01480$），並伴隨估計可追溯至約 217 萬年前的古老母系譜系。旁遮普觀察到最高的高倍型多樣性（$0.901 \pm 0.014$），其次為巴基斯坦南部（$0.893 \pm 0.026$）。系統發生與人口統計學分析（不匹配分佈、Fu's Fs 檢定）進一步支持一項早期擴散情景（I1 單倍群），即源自梅爾加爾，並透過印度河流域輻射至更廣泛的亞洲譜系。這些發現增進了我們對*Bos indicus*馴化起源的理解，及其對品種保育和永續畜牧管理的意涵。

papers.title: Effect of Selection for High Growth on Resilience of Giant Freshwater Prawn Macrobrachium rosenbergii
papers.abstract: Resilience is the capacity of an animal to be minimally affected by disturbances or to rapidly return to its pre‐disturbance state. To the best of our knowledge, no previous study has investigated resilience in the giant freshwater prawn (GFP, Macrobrachium rosenbergii ). In this study, we aimed to estimate the genetic parameters of resilience indicators, the correlations between resilience and growth and survival traits, and the correlated genetic responses to selection for high growth in the present GFP line. A resilience indicator based on standardised body weight (BW) deviation was analysed in 39,134 individuals (offspring of 810 females and 515 males), specifically the logarithm‐transformed variance (LnVar). The heritability estimate for the resilience indicator (LnVar) was low (0.09 ± 0.03) but statistically significant. The genetic correlations between LnVar and body weight (BW) and total length (TL) were moderate and positive (0.33 ± 0.04 and 0.18 ± 0.01, respectively), whereas those between LnVar and body and carapace widths were negative (−0.28 to −0.32). The correlated response of the resilience indicator (LnVar) to selection for high growth was low but favourable, averaging 0.77%–2.89% over eight generations, or only 0.002 and 0.006 phenotypic and genetic standard deviation units, respectively. In conclusion, this study demonstrates the presence of heritable genetic variation in the resilience indicator derived from BW deviations in the giant freshwater prawn. Selection for high body weight has slightly improved resilience in this species, highlighting the potential to enhance resilience through selective breeding, albeit at a slow rate.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics
papers.abstract_zh: 韌性是指動物受干擾影響極小或能迅速恢復至干擾前狀態的能力。據我們所知，先前並無研究探討巨大淡水蝦（巨蝦，Macrobrachium rosenbergii）的韌性。在本研究中，我們旨在估算韌性指標的遺傳參數、韌性與生長及存活性狀之間的相關性，以及本巨蝦品系對高生長選育的相關遺傳反應。本研究分析了 39,134 隻個體（810 隻雌蝦與 515 隻雄蝦的後代）基於標準化體重（BW）偏差的韌性指標，具體而言即對數轉換變異數（LnVar）。韌性指標（LnVar）的遺傳率估值雖低（0.09 ± 0.03）但具統計顯著性。LnVar 與體重（BW）及總長（TL）之間的遺傳相關性為中等且呈正相關（分別為 0.33 ± 0.04 與 0.18 ± 0.01），而 LnVar 與體寬及頭胸甲寬之間則呈負相關（-0.28 至 -0.32）。韌性指標（LnVar）對高生長選育的相關反應低但屬有利，在八個世代中平均為 0.77% 至 2.89%，表現型和遺傳標準差單位則分別僅增加 0.002 和 0.006。總體而言，本研究證明了巨大淡水蝦中源自體重偏差的韌性指標具有具遺傳性的遺傳變異。對高體重的選育已微幅改善了該物種的韌性，凸顯了透過選育來增強韌性的潛力，儘管進展速度緩慢。

papers.title: Veterinarians’ Perceptions of Farm Animal Pain and Views on Pain Management: Two Cross-Sectional Scenario-Based Surveys of Cattle and Pig Practitioners in Poland
papers.abstract: Two anonymous web-based surveys were administered to veterinarians working with cattle or pigs in Poland between March 2025 and February 2026 (101 responses per survey). Questionnaires assessed demographics, seven pain-related statements (5-point Likert scale), and pain ratings for clinical scenarios (0–10). Analyses used nonparametric tests with Benjamini–Hochberg multiplicity control and exploratory multivariable logistic regression. Agreement that pain mitigation improves recovery was nearly universal (cattle, 100/101; pigs, 95/101). In cattle, difficult calving, thermal disbudding, and castration were most often rated as severely painful (≥8/10; 88/101, 69/101, and 60/101, respectively). In pigs, limb fracture had a median rating of 10 and was rated ≥8/10 by 85/101 respondents, whereas tail-docking ratings varied widely. After multiplicity control, female cattle respondents more strongly endorsed insufficient analgesic options, whereas male pig respondents more strongly endorsed lower pain sensitivity in pigs than in humans. The latter belief correlated with lower mean pain ratings (ρ = −0.298). Among pig veterinarians, routine pain discussion was associated with self-reported knowledge (OR 2.11, 95% CI 1.13–3.93) and perceived limitations in analgesic availability (OR 2.24, 95% CI 1.15–4.37). These findings highlight veterinarians’ support for pain relief and identify areas for continuing education, communication with producers, and practical guidance on pain management.
papers.abstract_zh: 2025年3月至2026年2月間，波蘭針對從事牛隻或豬隻診療的獸醫進行了兩項匿名網路問卷調查（每項調查各獲得101份有效回覆）。問卷評估了受訪者的背景、七項與疼痛相關的陳述（採用5點李克特量表），以及對臨床情境的疼痛評分（0至10分）。分析採用非母數檢定，並以班傑明-霍克伯格（Benjamini–Hochberg）方法進行多重比較控制，同時進行探索性多元羅吉斯迴歸分析。幾乎所有受訪者皆認同緩解疼痛有助於康復（牛隻獸醫 100/101；豬隻獸醫 95/101）。在牛隻方面，難產、熱烙去角和去勢被最常評為劇烈疼痛（≥8/10分；分別為 88/101、69/101 及 60/101）。在豬隻方面，四肢骨折的中位評分為10分，且有 85/101 的受訪者評為≥8/10分，而尾部切除（斷尾）的評分則差異極大。在進行多重比較控制後，女性牛隻獸醫更強烈認同止痛選擇不足，而男性豬隻獸醫則更強烈認為豬隻的疼痛敏感度低於人類。後者的觀念與較低的平均疼痛評分呈負相關（$\rho = -0.298$）。在豬隻獸醫中，例行討論疼痛與自我評估的專業知識（勝算比 OR 2.11，95% 信賴區間 1.13–3.93）及對止痛藥物可取得性的侷限感知（勝算比 OR 2.24，95% 信賴區間 1.15–4.37）呈顯著相關。這些研究結果突顯了獸醫對止痛的支持，並指出了持續教育、與畜牧生產者溝通以及疼痛管理實務指引的改進方向。

papers.title: Effect of Rearing System and Season on Herbage Intake, Performance and Meat Nutritional Quality of Growing Rabbits
papers.abstract: Consumer demand for sustainable and animal-friendly systems has driven interest in alternative livestock management; however, its impact on productive performance and meat quality requires further validation. This study monitored outdoor-reared rabbits during the spring and autumn seasons over a 48 d experimental period, comparing this alternative system to cage-reared rabbits slaughtered at a fixed age (80 d). Forage and energy intakes were evaluated alongside a post-slaughter analysis of muscle lipid content, fatty acid profiles, and tocopherol deposition. Meat oxidative stability was assessed by measuring thiobarbituric acid reactive substances (TBARS). Data were analyzed using mixed linear models and Principal Component Analysis (PCA). The results demonstrate that pasture-based rabbit systems offer a suitable alternative to conventional cages. Although pasture access significantly reduced growth performance, with average daily gain dropping by up to 7.24 g/day and digestible energy intake decreasing by approximately 6.20 MJ in autumn-reared rabbits, it enhanced meat quality by yielding leaner muscle profiles and higher levels of n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs). Furthermore, although pasture-based systems are widely reported to increase physical activity—potentially elevating metabolic rate and oxidative load—the concurrent intake of natural antioxidants from fresh forage effectively maintained high oxidative stability in meat. Ultimately, these findings validate pasture-based systems as a viable approach to delivering high-quality meat within sustainable, welfare-friendly production frameworks.
papers.abstract_zh: 消費者對永續且動物友善飼養系統的需求，帶動了對替代性家畜管理模式的興趣；然而其對生產性能與肉質的影響仍需進一步驗證。本研究在春季與秋季對戶外飼養的兔子進行了為期48天的實驗監測，將此替代系統與固定屠宰年齡（80日齡）的籠飼兔子進行比較。評估了牧草與能量攝取量，並進行了屠宰後肌肉脂質含量、脂肪酸組成及生育酚沉積的分析。透過測定硫代巴比妥酸反應物（TBARS）來評估肉品的抗氧化穩定性。數據採用混合線性模型與主成分分析（PCA）進行分析。結果顯示，放牧兔隻系統可作為傳統籠飼的合適替代方案。儘管放牧顯著降低了生長性能，秋季飼養兔隻的平均每日增重下降高達7.24公克/天，且可消化能量攝取量減少約6.20百萬焦耳（MJ），但它透過產生較瘦的肌肉組織及較高水準的n-3多元不飽和脂肪酸（PUFAs），提升了肉品品質。此外，雖然廣泛報導指出放牧系統會增加體能活動——可能提高代謝率與氧化負擔，但同時攝取新鮮牧草中的天然抗氧化劑，有效地維持了肉品的高抗氧化穩定性。總體而言，這些發現證實了放牧系統作為在永續且兼顧動物福利的生產框架下提供高品質肉類的可行方法。

papers.title: The rate and spectrum of germline mutations in chicken from a commercial pedigree line
papers.abstract: Background Pedigree-based studies of germline mutations provide a direct understanding of the origin and consequences of genetic variation, and allow quantification of how mutations affect functional variation. Here, we use whole-genome sequencing data from 194 chicken ( Gallus gallus ) trios from a commercial pedigree line to estimate the germline mutation rate and spectrum, and to characterize patterns of mutational variation across the genome and genes, aiming to rank protein coding genes by their expected contributions to mutational variance ( V m ). Results We estimated a mutation rate of µ = 3.49 × 10 −9 mutations per nucleotide site per generation. A goodness-of-fit test (χ 2 13 = 10.97, P = 0.61) indicated that the number of new mutations per generation follows a Poisson distribution ( λ = 6.22). A read-based phasing approach revealed a strong sex bias, with males contributing approximately twice as many mutations as females. Microchromosomes showed a point estimate of mutation rate approximately 8% higher than macrochromosomes, likely owing to their higher GC content and a mutation spectrum dominated by C→T transitions. From this spectrum, we built a codon transition matrix and show that genes vary widely in their propensity to mutation based on codon composition, likely reflecting large differences in their contributions to V m . Specifically, we found that genes involved in immunity and development rank among those most prone to non-silent mutations. Conclusions Our results reveal predictable patterns of gene-level mutational variation and provide a framework for anticipating how new mutations generate functional variation. By bridging quantitative genetics and molecular biology, we provide a mechanistic basis for variation in V m across the genome, showing that heterogeneity in V m can arise from gene-specific features, particularly codon composition and mutational target size. These metrics offer a way to rank genes and prioritize genetic variants by their expected contributions to biological functions as a consequence of de novo mutation. This provides a new basis for informed management of genetic variation in breeding populations and for understanding the evolutionary dynamics of functionally important genes.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 基於譜系的生殖細胞突變研究能直接幫助我們理解遺傳變異的來源與後果，並允許量化突變如何影響功能性變異。在此，我們利用來自商業育種譜系中 194 個雞（Gallus gallus）三人組（trios）的全基因組定序數據，來估算生殖細胞突變率與突變譜，並表徵整個基因組及基因的突變變異模式，旨在根據蛋白質編碼基因對突變變異數（$V_m$）的預期貢獻進行排序。結果 我們估算出每個核苷酸位點每世代的突變率為 $\mu = 3.49 \times 10^{-9}$。適配度檢定（$\chi^2_{13} = 10.97, P = 0.61$）顯示，每個世代的新突變數量遵循卜瓦松分佈（$\lambda = 6.22$）。基於讀段（read-based）的定相方法揭示了強烈的性別偏向，雄性貢獻的突變數量約為雌性的兩倍。微小染色體的突變率點估計值比大型染色體高出約 8%，這可能歸因於它們較高的 GC 含量以及以 C→T 轉換為主導的突變譜。由此突變譜出發，我們建立了密碼子轉換矩陣，並表明基因根據密碼子組成在突變傾向上有很大差異，這可能反映了它們對 $V_m$ 貢獻的巨大差異。具體而言，我們發現參與免疫和發育的基因在最易發生非同義突變的基因中名列前茅。結論 我們的結果揭示了基因層面突變變異的可預測模式，並為預測新突變如何產生功能性變異提供了框架。透過連結量化遺傳學與分子生物學，我們為整個基因組中 $V_m$ 變異提供了機械式的基礎，表明 $V_m$ 的異質性可源自基因特異性特徵，特別是密碼子組成和突變標靶大小。這些指標提供了一種方法，可根據從頭突變（de novo mutation）對生物功能的預期貢獻來對基因進行排序並對遺傳變異進行優先排序。這為育種族群中遺傳變異的知情管理以及理解功能重要基因的演化動態提供了新的基礎。

papers.title: In Ovo Folic Acid Injection Modulates Hatchability, Hematobiochemical Profiles, Immune Status, and Intestinal Histomorphology of Day-Old Broiler Chicks
papers.abstract: This study evaluated the effects of in ovo folic acid administration on hatchability, physiological profiles, and intestinal development in day-old Cobb broiler chicks. A total of 600 embryonated eggs were assigned to five treatments: an uninjected control, a saline control, and three folic acid levels (50, 100, and 150 µg/egg) injected into the amnion on day 18 of incubation. Folic acid administration significantly improved hatchability, with 50 and 100 µg/egg achieving higher rates (98.83% and 99.45%) than the control (98.06%; p = 0.0405), alongside a linear increase in chick length (p = 0.0097). In contrast, egg weight, chick weight, and chick yield were unaffected (p > 0.05). Folic acid stimulated linear increases in the relative weight of the bursa of Fabricius, total white blood cells, lymphocytes, and serum IgM concentrations (p < 0.05). Erythrocyte counts, hemoglobin, and packed cell volume also increased linearly (p ≤ 0.0003). Serum biochemical profiling revealed linear increases in total protein, albumin, and thyroid hormones (T3 and T4), alongside linear declines in glucose, cholesterol, and creatinine (p ≤ 0.0028). Additionally, folic acid supplementation reduced serum aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and alanine aminotransferase (ALT). Systemic oxidative stress was reduced, marked by decreased malondialdehyde (MDA) and enhanced total antioxidant capacity (TAC) and glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px) activity (p < 0.05), peaking at 100 µg/egg. Furthermore, intestinal villus height, crypt depth, and surface area were significantly increased (p ≤ 0.0003), peaking at 100–150 µg/egg. Collectively, these findings indicate that in ovo folic acid supplementation supports physiological adaptation during the peri-hatch period and promotes intestinal development in newly hatched broiler chicks. It is recommended that modern hatcheries utilize an optimal dosage within the range of 100 to 150 µg/egg during late incubation to maximize hatchability, immune function, antioxidant defenses, and gut absorptive capacity.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究評估了胚胎內（in ovo）注射葉酸對剛孵化之 Cobb 肉雞之孵化率、生理特性及腸道發育的影響。試驗共使用 600 枚受精蛋，隨機分配至五個處理組：未注射對照組、生理食鹽水對照組，以及於孵化第 18 天注射三種不同劑量葉酸（分別為每枚雞蛋 50、100 及 150 µg）至羊膜中。結果顯示，葉酸注射顯著改善了孵化率，其中 50 與 100 µg/egg 組的孵化率（98.83% 與 99.45%）高於對照組（98.06%；p = 0.0405），同時雛雞身長也呈線性增加（p = 0.0097）。相對地，蛋重、雛雞重及雛雞孵化率（chick yield）則不受影響（p > 0.05）。葉酸刺激了法氏囊相對重量、總白血球數、淋巴細胞及血清 IgM 濃度的線性增加（p < 0.05）。紅血球計數、血紅素及紅血球容積比亦呈線性增加（p ≤ 0.0003）。血清生化分析顯示，總蛋白、白蛋白及甲狀腺荷爾蒙（T3 與 T4）呈線性增加，而血糖、膽固醇及肌酸酐則呈線性下降（p ≤ 0.0028）。此外，葉酸補充降低了血清天門冬胺酸轉胺酶（AST）與丙胺酸轉胺酶（ALT）的濃度。全身性氧化壓力獲得緩減，表現為丙二醛（MDA）降低，且總抗氧化能力（TAC）及麩胱甘肽過氧化酶（GSH-Px）活性增強（p < 0.05），並在 100 µg/egg 組達到峰值。再者，腸道絨毛高度、隱窩深度及表面積均顯著增加（p ≤ 0.0003），並於 100–150 µg/egg 組達到峰值。綜上所述，這些結果表明，胚胎內補充葉酸有助於支持圍孵化期（peri-hatch period）的生理適應，並促進剛孵化肉雞的腸道發育。建議現代孵化場在孵化後期使用 100 至 150 µg/egg 範圍內的最佳劑量，以最大化孵化率、免疫功能、抗氧化防禦及腸道吸收能力。

papers.title: Egg Morphology as a Phenotypic Indicator of Chick Sex and Early Growth in Thai Native Chickens
papers.abstract: Egg morphological characteristics have been associated with hatchability, chick quality, and sex-related variation; however, their relationships with juvenile growth in indigenous chickens remain unclear. This study evaluated associations among egg morphology, hatch weight, chick sex, and early growth in Thai native Pradu Hang Dum chickens. A total of 139 chicks were evaluated for egg length, egg width, egg weight, eggshell surface area, shape index, hatch weight, body weight, and chest circumference. Pearson correlation, multiple linear regression, logistic regression, receiver operating characteristic analysis, and exploratory path analysis were applied. Egg length was positively associated with body weight and chest circumference at 8 weeks, whereas shape index was negatively associated with both traits. Egg weight was strongly correlated with hatch weight (r = 0.721, p < 0.001). After adjustment for chick sex, egg weight and shape index were not independently associated with body weight at 8 weeks, whereas sex showed a strong association; the model explained 41.0% of the observed variation. For chest circumference, shape index and sex remained significant, and the model explained 18.0% of the variation. Logistic regression showed significant associations between egg morphometric traits and chick sex, with similar within-sample discrimination for shape index alone (AUC = 0.808) and the model combining egg length and width (AUC = 0.814). Exploratory path analysis showed significant paths from egg weight to hatch weight, hatch weight to 8-week body weight, sex to 8-week body weight, and 8-week body weight to chest circumference. Overall, egg morphology provided population-specific phenotypic information associated with chick sex and early development, but its independent value for explaining juvenile growth was limited after accounting for sexual dimorphism.
papers.abstract_zh: 雞蛋形態特徵與孵化率、雛鳥品質及性別相關變異有關；然而，其與本土雞隻幼期生長之間的關係仍不清楚。本研究評估了泰國原生黑尾土雞（Pradu Hang Dum）的蛋形態、孵化重、雛鳥性別與早期生長之間的關聯。共評估了 139 隻雛鳥的蛋長、蛋寬、蛋重、蛋殼表面積、形狀指數、孵化重、體重與胸圍。應用了皮爾森相關分析、多元線性迴歸、邏輯斯迴歸、受試者工作特徵曲線分析及探索性路徑分析。蛋長與 8 週齡的體重和胸圍呈正相關，而形狀指數則與這兩個性狀呈負相關。蛋重與孵化重高度相關（$r = 0.721, p < 0.001$）。在調整雛鳥性別後，蛋重與形狀指數與 8 週齡體重無獨立相關性，而性別則顯示出強烈的關聯；該模型解釋了觀察到的變異之 41.0%。就胸圍而言，形狀指數與性別仍具顯著性，且該模型解釋了 18.0% 的變異。邏輯斯迴歸顯示蛋形態測定性狀與雛鳥性別之間具有顯著關聯，僅使用形狀指數（$\text{AUC} = 0.808$）與結合蛋長和蛋寬的模型（$\text{AUC} = 0.814$）在樣本內具有相似的鑑別力。探索性路徑分析顯示，顯著的路徑包含從蛋重到孵化重、孵化重到 8 週齡體重、性別到 8 週齡體重，以及 8 週齡體重到胸圍。總體而言，蛋形態提供了與雛鳥性別和早期發育相關的族群特異性表現型資訊，但在考量性別二型性後，其解釋幼期生長的獨立價值有限。

papers.title: Former Foodstuff-Based Diets on the Quality and Sensory Properties of Eggs from Laying Hens
papers.abstract: In recent years, former food products (FFPs) have been gaining attention as alternative feed ingredients for more sustainable production systems. This study evaluated the impact of including FFPs on the quality of eggs produced by laying hens. A total of 180 Lohmann Brown® hens were divided into three groups and fed a control diet (CON), a diet containing 20% FFPs (T20), and a diet containing 40% FFPs (T40). Eggs, collected between 31 and 33 weeks of age, were evaluated for physical, chemical, and sensory characteristics. Egg weight, shape index, yolk and albumen weight, and edible portion were comparable (p > 0.05) among the groups. Moreover, shell thickness, shell weight, and shell proportion were unaffected (p > 0.05) by dietary treatments. Yolk color was affected by FFP inclusion, with reduced (p < 0.05) yellowness in the supplemented groups, likely due to the lower dietary xanthophyll content resulting from the partial replacement of corn. The inclusion of FFPs had limited effects on the sensory quality of the eggs, with differences (p < 0.05) in yolk color and albumen texture. These findings highlight the potential of FFPs as a viable feed ingredient in laying hen diets. Further research is needed to confirm their applicability in different diets and farming conditions.
papers.abstract_zh: 近年來，食品加工副產物（former food products, FFPs）作為實現更具永續性生產系統的替代飼料原料，備受關注。本研究評估了在產蛋雞日糧中添加 FFPs 對產蛋品質的影響。試驗共選用 180 隻羅曼褐（Lohmann Brown®）產蛋雞，隨機分為三組，分別餵食對照日糧（CON）、添加 20% FFPs 的日糧（T20）以及添加 40% FFPs 的日糧（T40）。收集雞隻 31 至 33 週齡產下的雞蛋，並評估其物理、化學及感官特性。結果顯示，各組間的蛋重、形狀指數、蛋黃與蛋白重量以及可食部分均無顯著差異（p > 0.05）。此外，日糧處理對蛋殼厚度、蛋殼重量及蛋殼比例也沒有顯著影響（p > 0.05）。FFPs 的添加影響了蛋黃顏色，補充組的黃色度降低（p < 0.05），這可能歸因於部分替代玉米導致日糧中葉黃素含量降低。FFPs 的添加對雞蛋感官品質的影響有限，僅在蛋黃顏色和蛋白質地上觀察到差異（p < 0.05）。這些研究結果突顯了 FFPs 作為產蛋雞日糧中可行飼料原料的潛力。未來仍需進一步研究，以確認其在不同日糧和飼養條件下的適用性。

papers.title: Preliminary Tolerability Assessment of Continuous Dietary Meloxicam in Broilers
papers.abstract: The anti-inflammatory activity of antimicrobial growth promoters (AGPs) has been proposed as one mechanism contributing to their beneficial effects on broiler performance, raising interest in pharmacological modulation of inflammation as a non-antibiotic strategy. This proof-of-concept dose-escalation study evaluated the safety of prolonged dietary exposure to meloxicam (MLX) and explored its effects on performance. Seventy one-day-old male Cobb 500 broilers were allocated to five treatments (n = 14): basal diet (BD), BD supplemented with 55 ppm zinc bacitracin (ZB), or MLX at 0.4, 1.2, or 3.6 mg/kg body weight. Birds were monitored for 42 days, with growth performance, hematology, serum biochemistry, and histopathology evaluated. No consistent treatment-related hematological alterations occurred, and serum biochemistry was unaffected at day 21. At day 42, MLX produced dose-related changes in albumin, calculated globulin, and alanine aminotransferase, while alkaline phosphatase showed a quadratic response. Feed intake differed at selected time points, but MLX did not consistently alter growth performance. Performance also did not differ from the ZB. No apparent treatment-related patterns of histopathological lesions were identified in the birds examined. No overt toxicity was detected under the conditions and sample sizes evaluated, although selected biochemical responses at day 42 warrant further investigation. These preliminary findings support studies with defined inflammatory challenges and specific pharmacodynamic markers but do not establish the safety or growth-promoting efficacy of prolonged dietary MLX administration.
papers.abstract_zh: 抗菌生長促進劑（AGP）的抗發炎活性被認為是其促進肉雞生效率機制之一，這引發了人們對利用抗發炎藥理調節作為非抗生素策略的興趣。本概念驗證劑量遞增研究旨在評估長期飲食攝取美洛昔康（meloxicam, MLX）的安全性，並探討其對生效率的影響。將七十隻一日齡Cobb 500雄性肉雞隨機分配至五個處理組（n = 14）：基礎日糧（BD）、添加 55 ppm 札尼克霉素（zinc bacitracin, ZB）之基礎日糧，以及添加 0.4、1.2 或 3.6 mg/kg 體重 MLX 之基礎日糧。試驗對肉雞進行了 42 天的監測，並評估其生長表現、血液學、血清生化值及組織病理學。在試驗期間未觀察到與處理相關的一致性血液學改變，且在第 21 天時血清生化值未受影響。在第 42 天時，MLX 引起了白蛋白、計算出的球蛋白和丙胺酸轉胺酶呈劑量相關的變化，而鹼性磷酸酶則呈二次方反應。攝食量在特定時間點有所不同，但 MLX 並未持續改變生長表現。生長表現與 ZB 組亦無顯異。在所檢視的雞隻中，未發現明顯與處理相關的組織病理學病變模式。在所評估的條件和樣本量下，未檢出明顯的毒性，儘管在第 42 天時觀察到的部分生化反應仍需進一步探討。這些初步結果支持以明確的發炎挑戰和特定藥效學標記進行的研究，但並未確立長期在飲食中投予 MLX 的安全性或促進生長的功效。

papers.title: Genome‐Wide Characterization of Heterozygosity‐Rich Regions in Kazakh Native Sheep Breeds
papers.abstract: Heterozygosity‐rich regions (HRR) are genomic segments characterized by high heterozygosity that may arise from admixture, introgression, or balancing selection and may harbor loci associated with adaptation and fitness‐related traits. This study aimed to characterize HRR patterns in five Kazakh sheep breeds using a publicly available OvineSNP50 genotyping dataset. After quality control, ~25 000 SNPs were retained for 1634 Akzhaiyk, 1089 Edilbay, 532 Kazakh Fine‐Wool, 932 Kazakh Semi‐Coarse, and 282 Saryarka sheep. HRR were detected separately in each breed using the sliding‐window approach in detectRUNS R package, with a minimum segment length of 250 kb, at least 10 SNPs per window and segment, and a maximum of two opposing homozygous and one missing SNP per window. The average number of HRR per individual ranged from 40.75 ± 6.38 in Saryarka to 54.75 ± 7.34 in Kazakh Fine‐Wool sheep. HRR lengths ranged from 259.07 kb to 3.26 Mb, with an average of 0.7 Mb across breeds. Seventeen HRR islands, defined as regions shared by HRR in at least 25% of individuals within a breed, were identified, including regions on chromosomes 8 and 17 shared across all breeds. Genes overlapping these islands were associated with cellular homeostasis, immunity, metabolism, growth, and stress response, while the HRR islands overlapped with QTL associated with health, wool characteristics, and reproduction. These findings highlight the potential of HRR analysis to identify candidate genomic regions relevant to adaptation and economically important traits, providing insights for the conservation and genetic improvement of Kazakh sheep populations.
papers.abstract_zh: 富含雜合性區域（Heterozygosity‐rich regions, HRR）是以高雜合性為特徵的基因組片段，可能源自基因滲入、滲透或平衡選擇，並可能包含與適應及適應度相關性狀關聯的位點。本研究旨在利用公開可得的 OvineSNP50 基因型資料集，表徵五個哈薩克綿羊品種中的 HRR 模式。經過品質控制後，分別保留了 1634 隻阿克扎伊克綿羊（Akzhaiyk）、1089 隻埃迪爾拜綿羊（Edilbay）、532 隻哈薩克細毛羊（Kazakh Fine‐Wool）、932 隻哈薩克半粗毛羊（Kazakh Semi‐Coarse）以及 282 隻薩雷阿拉克綿羊（Saryarka）的大約 25,000 個 SNP。使用 detectRUNS R 套件中的滑動視窗方法，在各品種中分別偵測 HRR，最小片段長度設定為 250 kb，每個視窗和片段至少包含 10 個 SNP，每個視窗最多允許兩個相反的純合子 SNP 和一個缺失的 SNP。每個個體的平均 HRR 數量從薩雷阿拉克綿羊的 40.75 ± 6.38 到哈薩克細毛羊的 54.75 ± 7.34 不等。HRR 長度介於 259.07 kb 至 3.26 Mb 之間，各品種的平均長度為 0.7 Mb。共鑑定出 17 個 HRR 熱點區（定義為在品種內至少 25% 的個體中共享的 HRR 區域），其中包括跨所有品種共享的第 8 號和第 17 號染色體上的區域。與這些熱點區重疊的基因與細胞恆定、免疫、代謝、生長和壓力反應相關，同時這些 HRR 熱點區與和健康、羊毛特性及繁殖相關的 QTL 重疊。這些發現凸顯了 HRR 分析在識別與適應及經濟重要性狀相關的候選基因組區域方面的潛力，為哈薩克綿羊族群的保育和遺傳改良提供了見解。

papers.title: Gene editing technologies in poultry: advances, applications, and future prospects
papers.abstract: SUMMARYThe chicken is an important model organism for research and a major global source of animal protein (eggs and meat). Recently developed genome-editing technologies have allowed the production of genetically engineered animals for agriculture and food production. Genome editing in chicken is a promising approach to enhance growth, disease resistance, productivity, and welfare traits. In this review, we explore the recent progress of gene-editing technologies in poultry production, such as CRISPR/Cas9 and base editing. Genome editing in poultry has been applied to improve traits, analyse gene function and boost resistance to disease. While significant progress has been made, there are still bottlenecks in the scaling up and regulatory approval of gene-edited poultry. This review highlights the latest developments in genome editing technologies and discusses ethical, regulatory and biosafety issues, such as animal welfare, food safety and environmental risks.
papers.abstract_zh:
摘要
雞是重要的研究模式生物，也是全球動物蛋白質（蛋與肉類）的主要來源。近期發展的基因編輯技術使得生產用於農業與食品生產的基因改造動物成為可能。在家禽中進行基因編輯是提升生長、抗病力、生產力與福利性狀的前瞻性方法。在本篇綜論中，我們探討了基因編輯技術在家禽生產中的最新進展，例如 CRISPR/Cas9 與鹼基編輯。家禽的基因編輯已被應用於改良性狀、分析基因功能以及增強對疾病的抵抗力。儘管已取得顯著進展，但在基因編輯家禽的規模化生產與法規批准方面仍存在瓶頸。本篇綜論重點介紹了基因編輯技術的最新發展，並探討了倫理、法規與生物安全等議題，例如動物福利、食品安全與環境風險。

papers.title: Dietary inclusion of a fermented rapeseed–seaweed blend alters immunity and intestinal microbial activity but not Ascaridia galli burden in laying hens
papers.abstract: 1. Dietary components that are pre-fermented with lactic acid bacteria have recently attracted attention and may positively affect performance and gut health in poultry. This study investigated whether a commercial feed ingredient (EP199), containing fermented rapeseed meal, wheat bran and seaweed, could control worm burden, intestinal microbiota profiles and intestinal fermentation patterns, as well as immune profiles of layers infected with Ascaridia galli.2. A total of 192, 20 week old Bovans Brown laying hens were randomly allocated into four treatment groups; control diet vs. EP199 diet and experimentally infected (EXP) vs. naturally infected (NAT). The EP199 diet partly replaced rapeseed cake at 6%. The infected hens were either naturally exposed to A. galli contaminated litter or received oral administration of 764 embryonated A. galli eggs per hen at 20 weeks of age for 12 weeks.3. Performance was unaffected by EP199 or infection. However, hens fed the EP199 diet had a significantly lower egg production 3-12 weeks post-infection (pi) compared to the control group (86.1% vs. 90.1%, P=0.044). There was no effect on intestinal worm burden (x=7.98 worms per hen) or immune competence, as assessed by mitogen activation of peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC). Despite similar nutrient profiles of the two diets, the hens fed the EP199 diet had significantly higher caecal levels of specific short chain fatty acids: acetic acid (79.8 vs. 71.0 mmol/kg digesta; P=0.020), propionic acid (35.0 vs. 30.1 mmol/kg digesta; P=0.005) and n-butyric acid (17.3 vs. 14.7 mmol/kg digesta; P=0.015).4. Compared to the control group, hens fed EP199 had a lower humoral A. galli-specific immune response, in terms of IgY serum titres at 10 weeks (2812 vs. 5291; P=0.002) and 12 weeks (10546 vs. 17668; P=0.025) pi. Hens fed the EP199 diet showed a significantly higher frequency of activated CD4+CD8+ T cells (28.7% vs. 21.9%; P=0.045).5. Feeding EP199 at 6% did not have an effect on severity of A. galli infection. However, EP199 showed an immunomodulatory effect and altered caecal microbial activity. Infection method (experimental vs. natural) influenced both the worm burden and immune parameters.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 經乳酸菌預發酵的飲食成分近年來備受關注，其可能對家禽的生產性能和腸道健康產生正面影響。本研究旨在探討一種包含發酵油菜籽粕、小麥麩皮和海藻的商業飼料原料（EP199），是否能控制感染雞蛔蟲（Ascaridia galli）之產蛋雞的蟲體負荷量、腸道微生物相概況、腸道發酵模式以及免疫概況。

2. 本試驗共使用192隻20週齡的Bovans Brown產蛋雞，隨機分配至四個處理組：對照飼料組對比EP199飼料組，以及試驗感染（EXP）對比自然感染（NAT）。EP199飼料以6%的比例部分取代油菜籽餅。感染組的母雞於20週齡起，分別自然暴露於受A. galli汙染的墊料中，或每隻母雞經口投予764個具感染力的A. galli蟲卵，持續12週。
