3. 生產性能不受EP199或感染的影響。然而，與對照組相比，餵食EP199飼料的母雞在感染後（pi）3至12週的產蛋率顯著較低（86.1% 對比 90.1%，P=0.044）。透過周邊血液單核細胞（PBMC）的有絲分裂原活化評估，腸道蟲體負荷量（x=7.98 隻蟲/每隻母雞）或免疫能力均未受影響。儘管兩種飼料的營養成分相近，但餵食EP199飼料的母雞其盲腸中特定短鏈脂肪酸濃度顯著較高：乙酸（79.8 對比 71.0 mmol/kg 食糜；P=0.020）、丙酸（35.0 對比 30.1 mmol/kg 食糜；P=0.005）及正丁酸（17.3 對比 14.7 mmol/kg 食糜；P=0.015）。

4. 與對照組相比，餵食EP199的母雞在感染後第10週（2812 對比 5291；P=0.002）與第12週（10546 對比 17668；P=0.025）之血清A. galli特異性IgY效價較低，顯示其體液免疫反應較低。餵食EP199飼料的母雞表現出顯著較高的活化型CD4+CD8+ T細胞頻率（28.7% 對比 21.9%；P=0.045）。

5. 以6%比例餵食EP199對A. galli感染的嚴重程度沒有影響。然而，EP199顯示出免疫調節作用並改變了盲腸微生物活性。感染方法（試驗感染對比自然感染）同時影響了蟲體負荷量與免疫參數。

papers.title: Decoding the lncRNA landscape in bovine mastitis: insights into immune regulation and gene networks underlying host response
papers.abstract: Background Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) are critical regulatory elements of gene expression and play a crucial role in immune regulation of disease, such as bovine mastitis. With this study we evaluated expression profile of lncRNAs in subclinical intramammary infection (sIMI) from two pathogens: Streptococcus agalactiae ( S. agalactiae ; Sa+) and Prototheca spp. (P+) and predicted their interaction with protein coding genes in 31 Holstein cows. Quantitative trait loci (QTL) annotation and enrichment analysis was carried out on the lncRNAs partner genes for a comprehensive overview of their potential association with phenotypic traits. Finally, Partial Correlation and Information Theory (PCIT) and Regulatory Impact Factor (RIF) algorithms were adopted to assess co-expression network of differentially expressed lncRNAs (DELs) and genes (DEGs). Results A total of 211, 146, 353 and 184 DELs were identified when comparing Sa+ vs. Neg, P+ vs. Neg, Sa+ vs. P+, and uninfected vs. infected animals (Mast vs. Neg), respectively. Most of these DELs were mainly located within genic regions, and 78% had not been previously annotated in the bovine reference genome. Overall S. agalactiae infection modulated both immune and metabolic pathways (lipid metabolism, extracellular matrix synthesis), whereas Prototheca spp. infection activated immune signaling networks (B-cell and innate immunity). Unique lncRNAs induced by Sa+ were predicted to target genes controlling fatty acid synthesis and milk fat QTLs, while P+-induced lncRNAs were found associated mostly with immune genes and somatic cell count QTLs. The co-expression network also revealed shared lncRNAs between the two types of infection suggesting a core response: both infections converge on common hub genes (e.g., EBF1 , BTLA ), indicating potential conserved host-defense mechanisms. Conclusions These results suggest that, despite distinct lncRNA expression patterns, the downstream regulatory pathways—particularly those linked to immune function—may converge toward a shared host response during subclinical intramammary infections. Together, these findings underscore the complexity of lncRNA-mediated regulation in the bovine mammary gland and highlight the need for functional studies to clarify the biological roles of these novel transcripts.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 長鏈非coding RNA（lncRNAs）是基因表現的關鍵調節元件，並在疾病的免疫調節中扮演至關重要的角色，例如牛乳房炎。本研究評估了來自兩種病原體：無乳鏈球菌（Streptococcus agalactiae，Sa+）與藻樣原體屬（Prototheca spp.，P+）引起的亞臨床乳房內感染（sIMI）中 lncRNAs 的表現圖譜，並預測其與 31 頭荷 Holstein 乳牛中蛋白質編碼基因的交互作用。對 lncRNA 伴侶基因進行了數量性狀基因座（QTL）註釋與富集分析，以全面了解其與表型性狀的潛在關聯。最後，採用偏相關與資訊理論（PCIT）以及調節影響因子（RIF）演算法來評估差異表現 lncRNAs（DELs）與基因（DEGs）的共表現網路。結果 在比較 Sa+ 對 Neg、P+ 對 Neg、Sa+ 對 P+ 以及未感染對感染動物（Mast 對 Neg）時，分別鑑定出總共 211、146、353 和 184 個 DELs。這些 DELs 大多位於基因區域內，且有 78% 尚未在牛隻參考基因組中被註釋。整體而言，無乳鏈球菌感染同時調節了免疫與代謝途徑（脂質代謝、細胞外基質合成），而藻樣原體屬感染則活化了免疫訊號傳遞網路（B 細胞與先天免疫）。預測由 Sa+ 誘導的獨特 lncRNAs 其標的為控制脂肪酸合成與乳脂 QTL 的基因，而 P+ 誘導的 lncRNAs 則被發現主要與免疫基因及體細胞數 QTL 有關。共表現網路也揭示了兩種感染之間共有的 lncRNAs，暗示了一種核心反應：這兩種感染皆匯聚於共同的樞紐基因（例如 EBF1、BTLA），顯示出潛在且保守的宿主防禦機制。結論 這些結果表明，儘管具有不同的 lncRNA 表現模式，但在亞臨床乳房內感染期間，下游調節途徑（特別是那些與免疫功能相關的途徑）可能會匯聚成共同的宿主反應。綜上所述，這些發現強調了牛乳房中 lncRNA 介導調節的複雜性，並突顯了進行功能性研究以闡明這些新穎轉錄本生物學角色的必要性。

papers.title: Postbiotics enhance immune competence in black rockfish (Sebastes schlegelii): linking innate immunity, apoptosis, and resistance to bacterial infection
papers.abstract: Background This study investigated the functional potential and safety of postbiotics derived from Latilactobacillus curvatus NBL2305 as a dietary feed additive for juvenile black rockfish ( Sebastes schlegelii ). Fish were fed diets supplemented with NBL2305-derived postbiotics, and their effects on growth performance, immune responses, antioxidant capacity, apoptosis-related gene expression, intestinal microbiota, and disease resistance were evaluated. Results Supplementation with postbiotics significantly improved growth performance and feed utilization, as indicated by increased weight gain and specific growth rate, along with a reduced feed conversion ratio. Innate immune responses were enhanced, as demonstrated by elevated activities of myeloperoxidase, superoxide dismutase, and lysozyme together with the upregulated expression of immune-related genes, including il8 , il1b , tnfa , tnfsf13b , and nfkb1 . In addition, postbiotic treatment modulated apoptosis-related gene expression in the liver, characterized by the downregulation of pro-apoptotic genes ( bax , tp53 , and casp3 ) and the upregulation of anti-apoptotic genes ( bcl2 and xiap ), indicating an anti-apoptotic gene expression profile. The postbiotics also exhibited strong antimicrobial activity against major fish pathogens and considerable antioxidant capacity. These functional effects were further supported by an in vivo challenge test, in which the postbiotic-fed group showed significantly higher survival following Edwardsiella tarda infection. No adverse effects were observed in serum biochemical parameters, somatic indices, or histopathological analyses, supporting the short-term safety of supplementation under the experimental conditions evaluated. Moreover, the intestinal microbiota composition remained stable, with selective enrichment of beneficial taxa. Conclusions Collectively, these findings demonstrate that NBL2305-derived postbiotics are safe and effective functional feed additives that enhance growth, modulated innate immune responses, and disease resistance in aquaculture species.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景 本研究旨在探討源自彎曲乳桿菌（Latilactobacillus curvatus）NBL2305 的後生元（postbiotics）作為幼黑鯛（Sebastes schlegelii）飼料添加劑的功能潛力與安全性。試驗魚餵食添加了 NBL2305 衍生後生元的飼料，並評估其對生長表現、免疫反應、抗氧化能力、細胞凋亡相關基因表現、腸道菌相及抗病能力的影響。結果 添加後生元顯著改善了生長表現和飼料利用率，表現為增重與特定生長率增加，同時飼料轉換率降低。先天性免疫反應顯現出提升，髓過氧化酶、超氧化物歧化酶及溶菌酶的活性升高，且免疫相關基因（包含 *il8*、*il1b*、*tnfa*、*tnfsf13b* 與 *nfkb1*）的表現量亦上調。此外，後生元處理調節了肝臟中細胞凋亡相關基因的表現，其特徵為促凋亡基因（*bax*、*tp53* 與 *casp3*）表現下調，而抗凋亡基因（*bcl2* 與 *xiap*）表現上調，顯示出抗凋亡的基因表現譜。該後生元對主要魚類病原菌亦展現出強效的抗菌活性與顯著的抗氧化能力。這些功能性效果進一步獲得活體攻毒試驗的證實，在感染遲緩愛德華氏菌（*Edwardsiella tarda*）後，餵食後生元的組別顯示出顯著較高的存活率。在血清生化參數、形質指數或組織病理學分析中皆未觀察到不良影響，支持了在所評估之試驗條件下短期添加的安全性。此外，腸道菌相組成保持穩定，並有益菌群獲得選擇性富集。結論 總體而言，這些發現表明 NBL2305 衍生的後生元是安全且有效的功能性飼料添加劑，能促進水產養殖物種的生長、調節先天性免疫反應並提高抗病能力。

papers.title: Investigating the Relationship Between Hoof, Liver, and Cardiac Abnormalities in Bos taurus Grain-Fed Beef Cattle < 30 Months in a Natural Program with No Antibiotics or Growth Promotants
papers.abstract: Our primary objective was to determine the relationship between hoof, liver, and cardiac abnormalities in a group of natural-fed cattle at slaughter. Bos taurus beef cattle (N = 1312), without dairy phenotype, were evaluated for abnormalities at a slaughter establishment in the Great Plains region of the United States (elevation: 563 m). Cattle were enrolled in a vegetarian-fed program that prohibited implants, diet-included hormones, and beta-adrenergic agonists. Generalized linear mixed models were used to determine the prevalence of each abnormality within other abnormalities. There was no detectable difference (p ≥ 0.1630) to support an association between the proportion of cattle with each hoof score within each heart or liver score. Cattle with no liver abscesses were more prevalent (p = 0.0355) among cattle with normal cardiac morphology (Heart Score (HS)1) (94.37 ± 1.19% (mean ± SE)) than cattle with HS2 (very mild remodeling) (88.6 ± 1.42%). Further research is needed to understand this observed difference between two similar heart scores and to further explore contributing factors to these production diseases.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究的主要目的是探討自然飼養肉牛在屠宰時蹄部、肝臟和心臟異常之間的關聯性。本研究評估了美國大平原地區（海拔：563公尺）一處屠宰場的肉用牛（Bos taurus）（N = 1312，不具乳牛表現型）之異常情況。這些牛隻納入一項禁止使用生長植入劑、飼料添加荷爾蒙及乙型受體促效劑的素食飼養計畫中。本研究採用廣義線性混合模型，以判定各項異常與其他異常之間的盛行率。結果顯示，並無可偵測的差異（p ≥ 0.1630）足以支持心臟或肝臟各評分中牛隻蹄部評分比例之間的關聯性。在心臟形態正常（心臟評分 [HS] 1）的牛隻中，無肝膿瘍的牛隻比例（94.37 ± 1.19% [平均值 ± 標準誤]）顯著高於具備 HS2（極輕微重塑）的牛隻（88.6 ± 1.42%）（p = 0.0355）。未來需要更多研究來釐清這兩個相近心臟評分之間所觀察到的差異，並進一步探討這些生產疾病的成因。

papers.title: Porcine Adenovirus-Based Viral Vectors for Swine Vaccines: A Scoping Review and Future Perspectives
papers.abstract: Porcine adenoviruses (PAdVs) are promising but still underdeveloped viral-vector platforms for swine vaccine development. Compared with human adenovirus-based vectors, PAdV vectors may offer potential advantages in host association, veterinary relevance, and mucosal delivery while avoiding direct reliance on common human adenovirus backbones. This review summarizes current knowledge on PAdV biology, vector engineering, vaccine applications, immune responses, translational challenges, and future priorities. Early studies showed that recombinant PAdV vectors can express heterologous antigens from important swine pathogens, including classical swine fever virus, pseudorabies virus, and transmissible gastroenteritis virus. The strongest direct proof-of-concept evidence comes from recombinant PAdV expressing classical swine fever virus E2/gp55, which induced neutralizing antibodies and protection in pigs. Comparative adenovirus-vectored swine vaccine studies support the broader feasibility of adenoviral antigen delivery for porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome, porcine epidemic diarrhea, swine influenza, and African swine fever, but these data should not be interpreted as direct validation of PAdV for these diseases. Major gaps remain in anti-PAdV immunity, genetic stability, biosafety, shedding, target-animal safety, DIVA compatibility, manufacturing, and regulatory readiness. Recent advances in PAdV-5 reverse genetics provide new opportunities for modern vector design.
papers.abstract_zh: 豬腺病毒（Porcine adenoviruses, PAdVs）是具潛力但發展尚不成熟的病毒載體平台，可用於開發豬用疫苗。與基於人類腺病毒的載體相比，PAdV載體在宿主相關性、獸醫學相關性及黏膜遞送方面可能具有潛在優勢，同時避免直接依賴常見的人類腺病毒骨架。本綜述總結了目前關於PAdV生物學、載體工程、疫苗應用、免疫反應、轉化挑戰及未來優先事項的知識。早期研究表明，重組PAdV載體能夠表現重要豬隻病原體的異源抗原，包括傳統豬瘟病毒、偽狂犬病病毒和傳染性胃腸炎病毒。最強而有力的直接概念驗證證據來自於表現傳統豬瘟病毒E2/gp55的重組PAdV，該載體能在豬隻體內誘導中和抗體與保護力。比較腺病毒載體豬用疫苗的研究支持了將腺病毒抗原遞送應用於豬繁殖與呼吸綜合症、豬流行性下痢、豬流行性感冒及非洲豬瘟的更廣泛可行性，但這些數據不應被解讀為PAdV針對這些疾病的直接驗證。在抗PAdV免疫力、基因穩定性、生物安全性、排毒、標靶動物安全性、DIVA相容性、製造工藝及法規準備度方面，仍存在重大缺口。PAdV-5反向 genética（反向遺傳學）的最新進展為現代載體設計提供了新契機。

papers.title: Dietary Chitosan Oligosaccharides Modulate Oxidative Status, Inflammatory and Apoptosis-Related Markers in Immune Organs of Heat-Stressed Broilers
papers.abstract: Chitosan oligosaccharides (COS) have antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities. This study characterized immune-organ responses associated with dietary COS in broilers exposed to cyclic heat stress (HS). A total of 192 birds were assigned to four groups (six cages/group; eight birds/cage): control (CON; 24 ± 1 °C), HS (34 ± 1 °C for 10 h/day), HS + 200 mg/kg COS, and HS + 400 mg/kg COS. Each treatment was replicated in three rooms, with two cages per room. One bird per cage was sampled after the final heat-stress bout and a 12 h fast (n = 6/group). Outcomes comprised organ indices and qualitative histology; serum corticosterone; splenic and thymic SOD, CAT, GSH-Px, and MDA; and heat-shock-, cytokine-, and apoptosis-related mRNA. Data were analyzed using a linear mixed model with treatment as a fixed effect and room nested within treatment as a random effect; Tukey-adjusted comparisons followed a significant omnibus test. Treatment was assigned at room level, the CON versus HS contrast was confounded with room temperature condition, and only three rooms were available per treatment, so all inferential comparisons are exploratory. Relative to unsupplemented HS, both COS doses increased spleen and bursa indices (p < 0.05), lowered serum corticosterone (p < 0.01), increased SOD and CAT activities (p < 0.01) and GSH-Px activity (p < 0.05), and lowered MDA (p < 0.05). COS groups also showed tissue- and dose-dependent shifts in mRNA. The 200 mg/kg group generally showed the largest reductions in pro-inflammatory transcripts, whereas 400 mg/kg produced the most consistent thymic apoptosis-related transcript pattern; no single dose was optimal across all endpoints. Dietary COS was therefore associated with altered immune-organ indices, measured oxidative status, and stress-, cytokine-, and apoptosis-related transcription under HS. Because no thermoneutral + COS group was included and room-level replication was limited, these findings require validation with replicated rooms, protein measurements, and functional immune endpoints.
papers.abstract_zh: 殼寡糖（COS）具有抗氧化及免疫調節活性。本研究旨在探討肉雞暴露於週期性熱應激（HS）下，日糧添加COS對其免疫器官反應的影響。試驗共選用192隻肉雞，隨機分配至四個組別（每組6個籠位，每籠8隻）：對照組（CON；24 ± 1 °C）、熱應激組（HS；34 ± 1 °C，持續10小時/天）、HS + 200 mg/kg COS組，以及HS + 400 mg/kg COS組。每個處理設有3個重複室，每室有2個籠位。在最後一次熱應激結束並禁食12小時後，每籠採樣1隻雞（n = 6/組）。檢測指標包括器官指數與定性組織學；血清皮質酮；脾臟與胸腺中的超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、過氧化氫酶（CAT）、麩胱甘肽過氧化物酶（GSH-Px）及丙二醛（MDA）；以及熱休克、細胞因子和細胞凋亡相關的mRNA表現。數據採用線性混合模型進行分析，以處理為固定效應，嵌套於處理內的室為隨機效應；顯著的綜合檢定後進行Tukey調整比較。由於處理係以室為單位指派，CON與HS之對比與室溫條件相互混淆，且每個處理僅有3個室可供使用，因此所有推論性比較均屬探索性質。與未補充COS的HS組相比，兩種劑量的COS均能增加脾臟與法氏囊指數（p < 0.05）、降低血清皮質酮（p < 0.01）、提高SOD與CAT活性（p < 0.01）及GSH-Px活性（p < 0.05），並降低MDA含量（p < 0.05）。COS組亦表現出具組織與劑量依賴性的mRNA轉錄變化。200 mg/kg組通常在促發炎轉錄本的降低幅度上最大，而400 mg/kg組則產生最一致的胸腺細胞凋亡相關轉錄本模式；就所有測定指標而言，並無單一劑量表現最優。因此，在熱應激下，日糧添加COS與免疫器官指數、所測之氧化狀態，以及壓力、細胞因子和細胞凋亡相關轉錄的改變有關。由於本研究未納入適溫（thermoneutral）+ COS組，且室級別的重複數有限，這些發現尚需透過具重複室的試驗、蛋白質測定以及功能性免疫指標進一步驗證。

papers.title: Longitudinal Genotype Replacement, Recombination and Neutralizing Epitope Variations in Porcine Epidemic Diarrhea Virus at a Commercial Pig Farm in Guangxi, China
papers.abstract: Porcine epidemic diarrhea virus (PEDV) causes severe enteric disease in piglets. The spike (S) gene is the major target of neutralizing antibodies and a hotspot for genetic variation. In this study, eight PEDV S-gene sequences were obtained from a commercial pig farm in Guangxi, China, between 2021 and 2025. Phylogenetic analysis assigned all sequences to the G2 genotype, with G2c, G2d, and G2b subclusters detected at different time points. Recombination analysis identified sequence-level recombination signatures in the G2c sequences, with G2b-like and G2d-like sequences as parental relatives. Several amino acid substitutions were located within or adjacent to the COE and SS2 neutralizing epitopes, and N-glycosylation site variations were observed among subclusters. Structural predictions suggest that these combined changes may alter surface antigenic properties and confer immune evasion potential, though functional validation using neutralization assays is still required. These findings provide field-derived evidence for PEDV genetic evolution and recombination within a single swine herd, and support rational vaccine-strain evaluation and on-farm biosecurity strategies.
papers.abstract_zh: 豬流行性下痢病毒（PEDV）會在仔豬身上引起嚴重的腸道疾病。棘蛋白（S）基因是中和抗體的主要標靶，也是基因變異的熱點。在本研究中，自2021年至2025年期間，從中國廣西的一個商業養豬場獲得了八個PEDV S基因序列。親緣 phylogenetic 分析將所有序列歸類於G2基因型，並在不同時間點檢測到G2c、G2d和G2b次群集。重組分析在G2c序列中識別出序列層級的重組特徵，其中以G2b樣和G2d樣序列作為親緣來源。多個胺基酸置換位於COE和SS2中和抗原表位內或其鄰近區域，且在各次群集中觀察到N-糖基化位點的變異。結構預測表明，這些綜合變化可能會改變表面抗原特性並賦予免疫逃脫的潛力，儘管仍需利用中和試驗進行功能驗證。這些發現為單一豬群內PEDV的基因演化與重組提供了來自現場的證據，並有助於合理的疫苗株評估與場內生物安全策略。

papers.title: New Insights into Avian Aerodynamic Valving: CT-Based CFD Analysis of Bronchial Airflow in the Domestic Chicken
papers.abstract: The avian respiratory system, characterized by its caudocranial unidirectional pulmonary airflow, has long fascinated scientists. To date, the mechanisms underlying the unidirectional airflow and the formation of aerodynamic valving, especially the expiratory valve, remain poorly understood. To provide new insights into pulmonary airflow characteristics and to deepen our understanding of the role of aerodynamic valving in generating unidirectional pulmonary airflow, the respiratory tract of a domestic chicken was reconstructed based on CT-scanned data. CFD simulations were performed under various conditions after validation of the numerical model. Flow parameters were analyzed qualitatively and quantitatively during inspiration and expiration phases, respectively. The results showed that the coupled interaction of the distinctive bronchial topology and air-sac pressure conditions preferentially routed inspired air toward the caudal-sac pathways during inspiration. During expiration, aerodynamic valving was primarily associated with a momentum barrier generated by the cranial-sac airstream, which suppressed retrograde caudal-sac airflow through the primary bronchus and redirected it toward the dorsobronchial outlets leading to the physiological paleopulmonic pathway. Moreover, the ‘segmentum accelerans’ structure facilitated the formation of aerodynamic valving, whereas its removal did not abolish major-bronchial flow rectification, although higher air-sac boundary pressures were required during expiration. Finally, fluid density substantially affected inspiratory aerodynamic valving, whereas its effect on the critical pressures associated with expiratory valving remained below 5%.
papers.abstract_zh: 鳥類呼吸系統具備尾向頭的單向肺部氣流特徵，長期以來一直令科學家著迷。迄今為止，單向氣流背後的機制以及空氣動力學瓣膜（尤其是呼氣瓣膜）的形成，仍所知有限。為了深入了解肺部氣流特性，並加深我們對空氣動力學瓣膜在產生單向肺部氣流中作用的理解，本研究基於斷層掃描（CT）數據重建了家雞的呼吸道。在驗證數值模型後，於各種條件下進行了計算流體力學（CFD）模擬。分別對吸氣和呼氣階段的流動參數進行了定性和定量分析。結果表明，獨特的支氣管拓樸結構與氣囊壓力條件的耦合交互作用，在吸氣過程中優選將吸入的空氣引導至尾囊路徑。在呼氣過程中，空氣動力學瓣膜主要與由頭囊氣流產生的動量障礙有關，該障礙抑制了通過主支氣管的逆行尾囊氣流，並將其重新導向通往生理古肺（paleopulmonic）路徑的背支氣管出口。此外，「加速段」（segmentum accelerans）結構促進了空氣動力學瓣膜的形成，而移除該結構並未消除主支氣管的氣流整流作用，儘管在呼氣過程中需要更高的氣囊邊界壓力。最後，流體密度顯著影響吸氣空氣動力學瓣膜，而其對與呼氣瓣膜相關的臨界壓力的影響則保持在 5% 以下。

papers.title: In silico evaluation of selected plant-based compounds as potent dual target inhibitors against highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 virus
papers.abstract: 1. Influenza viruses remain a serious global health issue due to their high morbidity and mortality rates. Among them, avian influenza H5N1 virus is highly pathogenic, causing up to 100% mortality in poultry. As the avian influenza H5N1 virus continues to mutate across different regions, understanding multiple viral proteins, particularly the mutated haemagglutinin (HA) and neuraminidase (NA), is crucial for effective control.2. In this study, dual-target inhibitors capable of neutralising both HA and NA were developed, and a comprehensive in silico analysis was performed on different variants collected over the past decade. Structural modelling revealed conserved domains in NA (A0A1I9QM14, China) and HA (A0A0A0V4U2, Bali), which were selected for ligand docking.3. Twenty active compounds, traditionally used as natural feed additives in broiler chicken diets, were screened using protein-ligand docking, ADME profiling, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. Quercetin and luteolin emerged as promising dual-target inhibitors, showing high binding affinity, drug-likeness, and favourable toxicity profiles. The binding free energy (ΔG = −8 ± 0.2 kcal/mol) from docking studies confirmed their inhibitory potential against avian influenza H5N1 virus HA and NA.4. The results demonstrated that virtual screening of natural compounds can effectively identify those effective against influenza virus surface proteins. This integrative computational-experimental strategy supported the development of novel plant-derived antiviral agents with potential applications for disease control.
papers.abstract_zh:
1. 由於流感病毒具有高罹病率與死亡率，至今仍是嚴重的全球健康問題。其中，A型流感H5N1病毒具有高度致病性，對家禽的致病死亡率可高達100%。隨著H5N1禽流感病毒在不同地區持續突變，深入了解多種病毒蛋白（特別是突變的血球凝集素〔HA〕與神經胺酸酶〔NA〕）對於有效防控至關重要。

2. 本研究開發了能同時中和HA與NA的雙標靶抑制劑，並對過去十年收集的不同變異株進行了全面的電腦模擬（in silico）分析。結構建模揭示了NA（A0A1I9QM14，中國）與HA（A0A0A0V4U2，峇里島）中的保守結構域，這些結構域被選用於配體對接。

3. 透過蛋白質-配體對接、ADME（吸收、分佈、代謝、排泄）分析與分子動力學（MD）模擬，篩選了二十種傳統上用作肉雞飼料天然添加物的活性化合物。槲皮素與木犀草素脫穎而出，成為具潛力的雙標靶抑制劑，展現出高度結合親和力、類藥性及良好的毒性學特性。對接研究所得的結合自由能（$\Delta G = -8 \pm 0.2\text{ kcal/mol}$）證實了它們對H5N1禽流感病毒HA與NA的抑制潛力。

4. 結果表明，天然化合物的虛擬篩選能有效辨識出針對流感病毒表面蛋白具療效的成分。此項整合計算與實驗的策略，支持了新型植物源抗病毒劑的開發，並在疾病防控方面具有潛在應用價值。

papers.title: Carbohydrate and protein adaptation in low-protein diets for livestock and poultry: a nutritional revolution from static balance to dynamic synergy
papers.abstract: Low-protein diet is a pivotal strategy for alleviating protein feed shortage and promoting the sustainable development of the livestock industry. However, the utilization efficiency of carbohydrate and protein nutrients in livestock and poultry remains relatively low, and carbohydrate-protein metabolism asynchrony is the core bottleneck limiting their efficient utilization. Carbohydrate and protein adaptation, based on low-protein diets, makes a shift from traditional static energy and nitrogen balance theories. By precisely aligning the digestive release patterns of carbohydrates and proteins, it enables the synergistic and efficient utilization of energy and amino acids, representing a promising concept in the low-protein diet systems. Nevertheless, current evidence supporting carbohydrate and protein adaptation remains relatively limited and largely based on indirect inference. This review summarizes the patterns of digestion and absorption of carbohydrate and protein in livestock and poultry as well as their key regulatory factors, clarifies the core technology and cutting-edge research methodologies for carbohydrate and protein adaptation, and analyzes the mechanisms by which carbohydrate and protein adaptation influences production performance, meat quality, intestinal health, and nutritional metabolism regulation. In addition, this review proposes future research directions, including quantitative and precise regulation, microbiome-targeted modulation, and multi-omics mechanism analysis, providing a theoretical basis for further research and industrial application of carbohydrate and protein adaptation in low-protein diets for livestock and poultry.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 低蛋白日糧是緩解蛋白質飼料短缺、促進畜牧業永續發展的關鍵策略。然而，畜禽對碳水化合物與蛋白質營養素的利用效率仍相對較低，而碳水化合物與蛋白質代謝不同步是限制其高效利用的核心瓶頸。基於低蛋白日糧的碳水化合物與蛋白質適配，使傳統的靜態能量與氮平衡理論發生了轉變。透過精準調控碳水化合物與蛋白質的消化釋放模式，實現能量與胺基酸的協同高效利用，是低蛋白日糧體系中極具前景的概念。然而，目前支援碳水化合物與蛋白質適配的證據仍相對有限，且大多基於間接推論。本文綜述了畜禽碳水化合物與蛋白質的消化吸收規律及其關鍵調控因素，闡明碳水化合物與蛋白質適配的核心技術與前沿研究方法，並分析碳水化合物與蛋白質適配影響生產性能、肉品品質、腸道健康及營養代謝調控的機制。此外，本文提出了未來的研究方向，包括定量與精準調控、以微生物組為標的的調節以及多體學機制分析，以期為畜禽低蛋白日糧中碳水化合物與蛋白質適配的深入研究與產業應用提供理論基礎。

papers.title: Cellular mechanism of gain-of-function mutation I173M in sheep MC4R gene identified in year-round and seasonal estrus breeds through whole-genome resequencing
papers.abstract: Background Investigating key genes regulating year-round estrus can improve sheep reproductive performance and industry efficiency. Although several candidate genes have been proposed, the key regulators underlying estrus seasonality remain unclear. Therefore, this study aimed to identify critical genetic variants associated with year-round estrus using whole-genome resequencing data from multiple sheep breeds. Results In this study, we analyzed whole-genome resequencing data from 392 sheep across six year-round and ten seasonal estrus breeds, and identified the Melanocortin 4 receptor ( MC4R ) gene as a key regulator of estrus seasonality. A missense mutation in the MC4R gene, I173M (g.59480440G > C; p.Ile173Met), was significantly enriched in year-round estrus breeds. Transcriptome analysis following MC4R I173M transfection revealed differential expression of genes enriched in reproductive pathways. Subsequent functional experiments demonstrated that the I173M mutation increased MC4R constitutive activity, activated cAMP and MAPK/ERK signaling, and promoted both granulosa cell proliferation and the expression of steroidogenic regulatory genes. Cells harboring the I173M mutation exhibited substantially amplified transcription levels of gonadotropin signaling components. Specifically, follicle-stimulating hormone receptor ( FSHR ) and luteinizing hormone receptor ( LHR ) were expressed at much higher levels relative to wild-type (WT) controls. Conclusions Our study provides evidence that MC4R functions as a molecular modulator of estrous cyclicity, with the I173M missense mutation identified as a critical functional variant driving constitutive estrous activity in ovine species.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：探討調節全年發情之關鍵基因有助於提升綿羊繁殖性能與產業效率。儘管先前已提出多個候選基因，但發情季節性背後的關鍵調控機制仍不清楚。因此，本研究旨在利用多個綿羊品種的全基因組重定序數據，鑑定與全年發情相關的關鍵基因變異。結果：本研究分析了來自 6 個全年發情品種與 10 個季節性發情品種共 392 隻綿羊的全基因組重定序數據，並鑑定出黑皮質素受體 4（MC4R）基因為發情季節性的關鍵調控因子。MC4R 基因中的一個錯義突變 I173M（g.59480440G > C；p.Ile173Met）在全年發情品種中顯著富集。MC4R I173M 轉染後的轉錄體分析顯示，參與生殖通路的基因表現出差異表現。隨後的功能實驗證明，I173M 突變提高了 MC4R 的組成型活性（constitutive activity）、活化了 cAMP 及 MAPK/ERK 信號傳遞路徑，並促進了顆粒細胞的增殖以及類固醇生成調節基因的表現。攜帶 I173M 突變的細胞表現出顯著增加的促性腺激素信號成分轉錄水平。具體而言，相較於野生型（WT）對照組，促濾泡素受體（FSHR）和促黃體素受體（LHR）的表現量顯著升高。結論：本研究提供了證據證明 MC4R 作為動情週期之分子調節因子發揮作用，其中 I173M 錯義突變被認定為驅動綿羊物種持續性發情活性的關鍵功能性變異。

papers.title: Gene-Length Bias and Compartment Non-Identifiability in Cell-Type Deconvolution of Sheep Skin: A Prospectively Specified and Timestamped Diagnostic Re-Analysis of Wool-Density Transcriptomes in Hetian Sheep
papers.abstract: Bulk skin transcriptomes cannot distinguish cell-intrinsic gene regulation from shifts in tissue-type composition, and computational deconvolution is widely applied to resolve this limitation. In this study, we performed deconvolution on published Hetian sheep skin RNA-seq data from three high-wool-density and three low-wool-density animals, using the available ovine skin single-cell reference. All hypotheses and analytical workflows were prospectively specified and timestamped prior to estimating cell-type fractions. Our work identifies two major methodological pitfalls for livestock tissue deconvolution. First, gene-length bias distorts deconvolution outputs derived from mixed bulk and 3′ single-cell references. After bias correction, the estimated hair-follicle epithelial fraction changed substantially. This bias cannot be uncovered by standard benchmark workflows, highlighting a hidden failure mode for deconvolution. Second, limited signature separability within the reference prevents reliable discrimination between related epidermal compartments. This non-identifiability strongly disturbs apparent compartment-level effects. When analysed at the granularity the reference reliably supports, we found no compositional difference between high- and low-wool-density groups for the epithelial hypothesis. The dermal hypothesis could not be meaningfully evaluated due to incompatible reference compartment merging requirements. Group-level differential expression remained robust despite this null compositional outcome. We recovered a large set of differentially expressed genes consistent with the original study, including most qPCR-validated candidates. Adjusting for cell-type composition altered part of this gene list, as expected given negligible group-level compositional divergence. Co-expression modules correlated more strongly with inter-individual compositional variation than with wool-density phenotype. This indicates compositional heterogeneity shapes transcriptome co-expression even without measurable mean differences across experimental groups. To avoid misleading biological inference, we propose a set of practical diagnostic checks for deconvolution when developmental or limited single-cell atlases are used for livestock tissues. Collectively, these transcriptomic patterns support cell-state-driven regulation rather than detectable mean shifts in tissue compartment composition.
papers.abstract_zh: 群體皮膚轉錄體無法區分細胞固有的基因調控與組織類型組成的轉變，而計算解convolution（去交織／反褶積）已被廣泛應用以解決此限制。在本研究中，我們對已發表、來自三個高羊毛密度與三個低羊毛密度個體的和田羊皮膚 RNA-seq 數據進行了解convolution，並使用了現有的綿羊皮膚單細胞參考群體。所有假設與分析工作流程皆在估算細胞類型比例之前預先指定並加蓋時間戳記。我們的工作指出了家畜組織解convolution的兩個主要方法學陷阱。首先，基因長度偏差會扭曲衍生自混合群體與 3′ 單細胞參考數據的解convolution輸出。在進行偏差校正後，估算的毛囊上皮細胞比例發生了顯著變化。此種偏差無法透過標準的基準測試工作流程被發現，這凸顯了解convolution中一個隱藏的失效模式。其次，參考數據內有限的特徵可區分性，阻礙了對相關表皮區室的可靠鑑別。這種不可辨識性強烈擾亂了表顯的區室層級效應。當以參考數據能夠可靠支援的精細度進行分析時，我們發現上皮細胞假設的高羊毛密度與低羊毛密度組之間並無組成上的差異。由於不相容的參考區室合併需求，真皮假設無法進行有意義的評估。儘管有此零組成的結果，組別層級的差異表現仍保持穩健。我們恢復了與原研究一致的大量差異表現基因，包括大多數經 qPCR 驗證的候選基因。正如在組別層級組成差異微乎其微的情況下所預期的，調整細胞類型組成改變了部分此基因列表。共表現模組與個體間組成變異的相關性，大於其與羊毛密度表現型的相關性。這表明即使在實驗組之間沒有可測量的平均差異的情況下，組成異質性仍會形塑轉錄體共表現。為了避免誤導性的生物學推論，當針對家畜組織使用發育中或有限的單細胞圖譜進行解convolution時，我們提出了一套實用的診斷檢查方法。總體而言，這些轉錄體模式支持的是細胞狀態驅動的調控，而非組織區室組成中可偵測到的平均轉移。

papers.title: Use of Encapsulated and Raw Organic Acids for Inhibition of Salmonella in a Refrigerated Raw Meat-Based Diet (RMBD) Matrix for Dogs
papers.abstract: The rising demand for using raw meat diets (RMBDs) for feeding companion animals requires improvement in their food safety. Organic acids could be a promising anti-microbial ingredient for mitigating pathogen contamination. This study investigated the effects of encapsulated (E) and raw (R) acids (citric—CE and CR; lactic—LE and LR) on Salmonella survival in RMBDs during refrigerated storage. The acidulants (1.0% LE, 1.0% CE, 0.5% LE + 0.5% CE, 0.5% CE + 0.5% LR, 0.5% LE + 0.5% CR, and 0.5% LR + 0.5% CR) were incorporated in RMBD patties inoculated with Salmonella (ATCC 8326, ATCC 14802, and ATCC 13076) at 6 and 9 log CFU/patty levels. Inoculated (PC) and non-inoculated (NC) patties made without acidulants were used as controls. Patties were stored at 4 °C and Salmonella enumeration was done at days 0, 1, 4, 7, 10, 13, 16, 19, and 22. Salmonella reduction was higher (p < 0.05) in stored patties with both encapsulated and raw acids (3.10–4.10 logs) added relative to using individual encapsulated acids (2.40–3.70 logs) and control (0.70–0.90 logs). Higher inoculation levels resulted in greater (p < 0.05) Salmonella reductions in the patties after storage. The reductions were influenced (p < 0.05) by the treatment × time interaction with longer storage time resulting in higher reductions. The Salmonella inactivation under all acid treatments followed the Weibull model (R2—0.86 to 0.98; RMSE—0.19 to 0.34; β—1.23 to 2.08). The results show that encapsulated organic acids can inhibit Salmonella growth and survival in RMBDs under refrigerated conditions. The results from this study could be used as basis for improving the food safety of RMBDs.
papers.abstract_zh: 餵食伴侶動物生肉飲食（RMBDs）的需求不斷上升，這有必要提升其食品安全。有機酸可能是一種有潛力的抗菌成分，可用於降低病原菌污染。本研究探討了微膠囊化（E）與原生（R）有機酸（檸檬酸——CE 和 CR；乳酸——LE 和 LR）對冷藏期間 RMBDs 中沙門氏菌存活的影響。酸化劑（1.0% LE、1.0% CE、0.5% LE + 0.5% CE、0.5% CE + 0.5% LR、0.5% LE + 0.5% CR 以及 0.5% LR + 0.5% CR）被添加至接種了沙門氏菌（ATCC 8326、ATCC 14802 和 ATCC 13076，接種量為 6 和 9 log CFU/塊）的 RMBD 肉餅中。未添加酸化劑的接種肉餅（PC）與未接種肉餅（NC）作為對照組。肉餅儲存於 4 °C，並於第 0、1、4、7、10、13、16、19 和 22 天進行沙門氏菌計數。相較於單獨使用微膠囊化酸（2.40–3.70 logs）和對照組（0.70–0.90 logs），添加微膠囊化酸與原生酸結合的儲存肉餅其沙門氏菌削減量更高（p < 0.05，達 3.10–4.10 logs）。較高的接種量導致肉餅在儲存後有更大的沙門氏菌削減量（p < 0.05）。削減量受到處理方式與時間交互作用的影響（p < 0.05），較長的儲存時間會導致更高的削減量。所有酸處理下的沙門氏菌去活性皆符合韋伯模型（Weibull model，R² = 0.86 至 0.98；RMSE = 0.19 至 0.34；β = 1.23 至 2.08）。研究結果顯示，微膠囊化有機酸能有效抑制冷藏條件下 RMBDs 中沙門氏菌的生長與存活。本研究的結果可作為改善 RMBDs 食品安全的基礎。

papers.title: Association of VCS2000-Measured Carcass Traits with Anatomical Site-Specific Fat Deposition and Appearance Acceptability of Pork Belly
papers.abstract: The primary objective of this study was to evaluate the utility of automated carcass parameters (VCS2000) in reflecting site-specific fat distribution along the thoracic (TV) and lumbar vertebrae (LV) of pork bellies. Additionally, this study aimed to determine how VCS2000-derived carcass weight and fat proportion influence localized fat accumulation and the resulting visual acceptability of these distinct anatomical sites. Total fat content, evaluated via the VCS2000 system, showed a positive loading on principal component 1 along with carcass weight, backfat thickness at various sites, and fat percentages at anatomical belly sites, demonstrating a close association with specific belly traits. Considering the carcass weight, belly weight, and belly fat accumulation at anatomical belly sites, carcasses with a higher weight but a lower fat percentage exhibited more favorable belly traits among all evaluated carcasses (p < 0.05). Anatomical location significantly influenced visual acceptability, with panelists preferring leaner sections (the 13th and 14th TV) over those with heavy fat accumulation (the 10th and 11th TV; p < 0.05). These results suggest that visual acceptability may be primarily driven by the localized distribution and structural balance of fat and lean meat, rather than the absolute fat proportion of pork belly.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究的主要目的在於評估自動化屠體性狀測量系統（VCS2000）反映豬腹肉沿著胸椎（TV）與腰椎（LV）特定部位脂肪分布之效用。此外，本研究旨在探討源自VCS2000之屠體重量與脂肪比例如何影響局部脂肪蓄積，以及這些不同解剖部位隨之產生的外觀接受度。透過VCS2000系統評估之總脂肪含量，與主成分1呈現正向負荷，同時伴隨屠體重量、各部位背脂厚度以及腹肉解剖部位之脂肪百分比，顯示其與特定腹肉性狀具有密切關聯。綜合考量屠體重量、腹肉重量以及腹肉解剖部位之脂肪蓄積，在所有評估的屠體中，具有較高重量但較低脂肪百分比的屠體表現出較佳的腹肉性狀（p < 0.05）。解剖位置對外觀接受度有顯著影響，評審員偏好較瘦的切段（第13與14節胸椎），勝過脂肪蓄積較多的切段（第10與11節胸椎；p < 0.05）。這些結果顯示，外觀接受度可能主要取決於脂肪與瘦肉的局部分布及結構平衡，而非豬腹肉的絕對脂肪比例。

papers.title: Genome‐Wide Association Studies for Anogenital Distance and Linear Type Traits in Gir Cattle
papers.abstract: Although linear type traits have been under selection in the Dairy Gir cattle for the past three decades, there are few studies exploring genetic architecture for these traits. The aim of this study was to identify candidate genes for anogenital distance and linear type traits in the Gir breed. For this study, the body measures of rump length (cm, RL), ilium width (cm, ILW), hip height (cm, HH), body length (cm, BL), thoracic perimeter (cm, TP) and rump area (cm 2 , RA) along with anogenital distance (cm, AGD) were collected from 604 Gir dairy cows, around 5.69 years old. The pedigree file included 2206 animals, of which 742 were genotyped with different SNP panels and imputed to Illumina BovineHD BeadChip (777 K). Genome‐wide association studies were carried out using the blupf90+ program for all traits and for a phenotypic index created to assist selecting candidate genes. The top 5 windows for the traits and top 10 windows for the index explaining the highest percentage of additive genetic variance were selected for gene search. Biological processes and transcription factors were searched from the genes found. In total, 90 genes were identified for all seven traits, of which 17 were pleiotropic, that is, they were common results for pairs or trios of traits. From that, the candidate genes (chromosome) identified from the phenotypic index were CXCL13 (6), CNOT6L (6), MRPL1 (6), CCSER1 (6), CDH26 (13), DOCK8 (8), ZNG1 (8) and PGM5 (8). For those eight genes, 11 transcription factors and 59 biological processes were identified. In conclusion, BTA6 seems to have a deeper role in linear type traits in the Gir breed. Even though there are few studies confirming the action of those genes on body conformation, all eight candidate genes are recommended for future studies to validate their action on muscle and skeletal development or fat deposition due to their biological process functions, which could be pleiotropically affecting linear traits in cattle.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Breeding and Genetics
papers.abstract_zh: 儘管乳用吉爾牛（Dairy Gir）在過去三十年間一直進行線性外貌特徵的選育，但探索這些特徵遺傳架構的研究卻十分稀少。本研究旨在識別吉爾牛品種中肛門生殖器距離與線性外貌特徵的候選基因。在本研究中，共收集了 604 頭平均年齡約 5.69 歲的乳用吉爾牛之體型測量數據，包括臀長（公分，RL）、髂骨寬（公分，ILW）、髖高（公分，HH）、體長（公分，BL）、胸圍（公分，TP）及臀部面積（平方公分，RA），以及肛門生殖器距離（公分，AGD）。譜系檔案包含 2206 個體，其中 742 個體使用不同的 SNP 晶片進行基因分型，並聚集（impute）至 Illumina BovineHD BeadChip（777K）。使用 blupf90+ 程式對所有特徵以及為協助選擇候選基因而建立的表型指數進行全基因體關聯性研究（GWAS）。選取解釋最高百分比加性遺傳變異的前 5 個特徵基因體視窗及前 10 個指數基因體視窗進行基因搜尋。並自所發現的基因中搜尋其生物學過程與轉錄因子。總計為所有七個特徵識別出 90 個基因，其中 17 個具多效性（pleiotropic），亦即它們是成對或成三特徵組合的共同結果。其中，由表型指數識別出的候選基因（染色體）為 CXCL13 (6)、CNOT6L (6)、MRPL1 (6)、CCSER1 (6)、CDH26 (13)、DOCK8 (8)、ZNG1 (8) 及 PGM5 (8)。針對這八個基因，識別出 11 個轉錄因子與 59 個生物學過程。總結來說，BTA6 似乎在吉爾牛的線性外貌特徵中扮演更深層的角色。儘管目前少有研究證實這些基因對體型構造的作用，但基於其生物學過程功能，這八個候選基因皆被推薦用於未來研究，以驗證其對肌肉、骨骼發育或脂肪沉積的作用，這些作用可能會多效性地影響牛隻的線性特徵。

papers.title: Genome‐Wide SNP Discovery and Population Genomic Characterisation in Indian Major Carp Labeo catla (Hamilton, 1822) Through Low‐Depth Whole‐Genome Resequencing
papers.abstract: Single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) are key markers for population and conservation genetics in aquaculture species. Using low‐depth whole‐genome resequencing of 35 Labeo catla individuals from seven populations (three wild riverine, four hatchery), we generated the first genome‐wide SNP catalogue for this Indian major carp. Filtering against the L. catla reference genome (GCA_012976165.1) yielded 2.05 million high‐quality bi‐allelic SNPs (467 291–1 221 268 per population), with 27 000 shared across all populations. Heterozygosity (He = 0.4477–0.4532) and nucleotide diversity ( π = 0.4703–0.4816) were broadly comparable across populations. Pairwise F ST (0.079–0.106) and UPGMA clustering resolved Cauvery as most divergent population, grouping the remaining six into two clusters (PCA: PC1 = 21.4%, PC2 = 16.8%). A differentiation scan identified 270 candidate high‐differentiation SNPs (top 1%; score > 0.222) enriched for missense variants (~2.05‐fold; p = 0.021), implicating cell‐adhesion, extracellular‐matrix and muscle‐development genes in population differentiation. An independent chi‐square test of allele‐frequency heterogeneity, corrected for multiple testing ( q < 0.05), retained 114 of these 270 SNPs, mapping to 30 genes whose GO profile (endosome, granule and endolysosome lumen) differed from the broader 270‐SNP set indicating exploratory, hypothesis generating candidates rather than confirmed selection targets. Genome‐wide annotation of 2 521 013 SNPs classified 108 113 (1.14%) as moderate‐impact missense and 5266 (0.06%) as high‐impact variants. These findings align with prior genotyping‐by‐sequencing data but extend marker density ~200‐fold, providing the first genome‐wide diversity, differentiation and functional profile for L. catla . The dataset (BioProject PRJNA1441081; Figshare doi: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.31829770 ) supports SNP array design, GWAS and conservation monitoring of Catla riverine stocks.
papers.abstract_zh: 單核苷酸多型性（SNPs）是水產物種族群與保育遺傳學的關鍵標記。本研究利用來自七個族群（三個野生河川族群、四個孵化場族群）共 35 尾印度卡特魚（Labeo catla）之低深度全基因組再定序，建立了此一印度大型鯉科魚類的的首個基因組範圍 SNP 目錄。經對照 L. catla 參考基因組（GCA_012976165.1）進行過濾，共獲得 205 萬個高品質雙等位基因 SNPs（每個族群 467,291–1,221,268 個），其中 27,000 個為所有族群所共有。各族群間的雜合度（He = 0.4477–0.4532）與核苷酸多樣性（π = 0.4703–0.4816）大致相當。成對 $F_{ST}$（0.079–0.106）及 UPGMA 分群顯示，考韋里河（Cauvery）族群分化程度最高，其餘六個族群則聚為兩群（PCA：PC1 = 21.4%，PC2 = 16.8%）。分化掃描辨識出 270 個高分化候選 SNPs（前 1%；評分 > 0.222），其錯義變異顯著富集（約 2.05 倍；p = 0.021），暗示細胞黏附、細胞外基質及肌肉發育基因參與了族群分化。經多重檢定校正（q < 0.05）的等位基因頻率異質性獨立卡方檢定，保留了這 270 個 SNP 中的 114 個，這些 SNP 對應至 30 個基因，其基因本體（GO）特徵（內體、顆粒及內溶小體腔）與更廣泛的 270-SNP 集合有所不同，表明這些是探索性、具假說生成性質的候選基因，而非已確認的選擇標的。2,521,013 個 SNPs 的基因組範圍註釋將 108,113 個（1.14%）歸類為中等影響的錯義變異，5,266 個（0.06%）歸類為高影響變異。這些發現與先前的定序分型（GBS）數據一致，但將標記密度提高了約 200 倍，為卡特魚提供了首個基因組範圍的多樣性、分化與功能概況。本研究數據集（BioProject PRJNA1441081；Figshare doi: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.31829770）支援卡特魚河川原種之 SNP 晶片設計、全基因組關聯分析（GWAS）及保育監測。

papers.title: Detection of Myoglobin Gene Polymorphism Associated With Pigeons' Growth Traits
papers.abstract: Utilizing single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) genotyping techniques to select animals with high economic trait values, including reproduction and growth, have attracted great attention. Myoglobin (Mb) is a cytoplasmic hemoprotein involved in oxygen transport and storage, and plays a critical role in skeletal muscle development. Nevertheless, there are few academic publications focused on the Mb associated with pigeons growth traits. Hence, the SNPs in the Mb gene were investigated and their association with growth‐related traits in pigeons was evaluated in this study. A total of 6 SNPs of Mb were identified in 260 pigeons. Among these, three SNPs (g.174230157G>C, g.174230158T>C and g.174230175T>G) were located in intron 1, one SNP was located in the exon 2 (g.174230233C>T), two SNPs (g.174231334T>C and g.174231495T>C) were located in 3′‐untranslated region (3′‐UTR) of the pigeon Mb gene. The results of the potential structural effects of these SNPs on mRNA analyzing via RNAfold software showed that the g.174230233C>T and g.174231334T>C mutations had unchanged on mRNA secondary structure, whereas the g.174231495T>C mutation is predicted to result in increased free energy. Genetic analysis indicated that all 6 SNPs conformed to Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium and with observed heterozygosity (Ho) exceeding expected heterozygosity ( H e ). Additionally, g.174230233C>T, g.174231334T>C and g.174231495T>C showed moderate polymorphism. Association analysis revealed significant correlations between g.174231334T>C and g.174231495T>C and shank circumference, whereas the remaining 4 SNPs showed no significant associations with growth traits. However, haplotype analysis showed no significant relationships with growth traits ( p > 0.05). These findings reveal novel Mb gene markers associated with pigeon growth traits and offer a molecular foundation for genetic improvement in pigeon breeding programs.
papers.abstract_zh: 利用單核苷酸多型性（SNP）基因型分型技術來選擇具備高經濟性狀價值（包含繁殖與生長）的動物，已引起廣泛關注。肌紅蛋白（Mb）是一種參與氧氣運輸與儲存的細胞質血红蛋白，並在骨骼肌發育中扮演關鍵角色。然而，專注於探討鴿子生長性狀之 Mb 相關的學術文獻卻寥寥無幾。因此，本研究旨在探討 Mb 基因中的 SNP，並評估其與鴿子生長相關性狀的關聯性。本研究在 260 隻鴿子中共鑑定出 6 個 Mb 的 SNP。其中，三個 SNP（g.174230157G>C、g.174230158T>C 及 g.174230175T>G）位於內含子 1（intron 1），一個 SNP 位於外顯子 2（exon 2；g.174230233C>T），兩個 SNP（g.174231334T>C 及 g.174231495T>C）則位於鴿子 Mb 基因的 3′ 端非轉譯區（3′-UTR）。利用 RNAfold 軟體分析這些 SNP 對 mRNA 潛在結構的影響結果顯示，g.174230233C>T 與 g.174231334T>C 突變對 mRNA 二級結構沒有改變，而預測 g.174231495T>C 突變則會導致自由能增加。遺傳分析顯示，所有 6 個 SNP 皆符合哈代－溫堡平衡（Hardy–Weinberg equilibrium），且觀察到的雜合度（$H_o$）大於預期雜合度（$H_e$）。此外，g.174230233C>T、g.174231334T>C 與 g.174231495T>C 呈現中度多型性。關聯性分析顯示，g.174231334T>C 與 g.174231495T>C 和脛圍呈顯著相關，而其餘 4 個 SNP 與生長性狀則無顯著關聯。然而，單套型（haplotype）分析顯示其與生長性狀無顯著相關性（$p > 0.05$）。這些發現揭示了與鴿子生長性狀相關的新穎 Mb 基因標記，並為鴿子育種計畫中的遺傳改良提供了分子基礎。

papers.title: Integrated single-cell and metabolomic profiling identifies ovarian metabolic differences and endothelial heterogeneity associated with litter-size variation in Hu sheep
papers.abstract: Background Hu sheep are highly prolific, but litter size remains variable among individuals. How ovarian metabolism and somatic-cell heterogeneity are associated with this variation remains unclear. Ovarian metabolites from high-litter-size (HLS) and low-litter-size (LLS) Hu ewes were profiled by liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry and gas chromatography–mass spectrometry. Ovarian cell populations and transcriptional states were characterized by single-cell RNA sequencing. Integrated analyses were used to relate metabolic differences to specific cell populations and predicted cell–cell communication. RT-qPCR and multiplex immunofluorescence were used to examine selected metabolic genes and the endothelial localization of ESM1. Separate cell experiments assessed the effects of endothelial cell-conditioned medium (EC-CM) and recombinant human IGFBP3 on primary ovine granulosa cells (GCs), with TMEM219 knockdown used to evaluate receptor involvement. Results HLS ovaries showed higher L-carnitine abundance, whereas several representative sphingomyelin species were more abundant in LLS ovaries (nominal P < 0.05). Integrated analysis identified two EC associated genes: DNAJB4 was downregulated, whereas NDRG1 was upregulated in HLS ovaries ( P < 0.05). At the EC level, gene set enrichment analysis showed significant enrichment of glutathione metabolism and oxidative phosphorylation in the HLS group. EC subclustering further associated these transcriptional programs with ESM1⁺ angiogenic endothelial cells (A-ECs). Multiplex immunofluorescence localized ESM1 to VWF-positive vascular structures and showed a significantly larger ESM1-positive area and more VWF/ESM1 double-positive cells in HLS ovaries ( P < 0.05). Cell–cell communication analysis identified IGFBP3–TMEM219 as a candidate EC–GC interaction. IGFBP3 was detected in EC-conditioned medium, which significantly reduced EdU incorporation and the expression of CYP11A1 , FSHR and STAR ( P < 0.05) in granulosa cells. Recombinant IGFBP3 produced similar responses, and TMEM219 knockdown partially attenuated several of these effects. Conclusions This study identified an association between exploratory ovarian metabolic patterns and EC heterogeneity, while functional experiments showed that EC-derived IGFBP3 affected GC function partly through TMEM219. These findings suggest that endothelial state and signaling may be relevant to follicular development, although whether IGFBP3–TMEM219 signaling contributes to litter-size variation in Hu sheep remains to be established.
papers.journal: Journal of Animal Science and Biotechnology
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：湖羊多產，但個體間的產羔數仍存在差異。卵巢代謝與體細胞異質性如何與此差異相關聯，目前尚不清楚。本研究利用液相層析－質譜法和氣相層析－質譜法，對高產羔數（HLS）與低產羔數（LLS）湖羊的卵巢代謝物進行了分析。透過單細胞RNA定序表徵卵巢細胞群與轉錄狀態。採用整合分析將代謝差異與特定細胞群及預測的細胞間通訊聯繫起來。利用即時螢光定量PCR（RT-qPCR）和多重免疫螢光技術檢驗選定的代謝基因以及ESM1的內皮細胞定位。獨立的細胞實驗評估了內皮細胞條件培養基（EC-CM）和重組人類IGFBP3對初級綿羊顆粒細胞（GCs）的影響，並使用TMEM219基因敲減來評估受體的參與情況。結果：HLS卵巢顯示出較高的L-肉鹼豐度，而幾種具代表性的神經鞘磷脂（sphingomyelin）物種在LLS卵巢中更為豐富（名義P < 0.05）。整合分析識別出兩個與內皮細胞（EC）相關的基因：DNAJB4在HLS卵巢中下調，而NDRG1上調（P < 0.05）。在內皮細胞層面，基因集富集分析顯示HLS組的穀胱甘肽代謝和氧化磷酸化顯著富集。內皮細胞亞群聚進一步將這些轉錄程式與ESM1⁺血管新生內皮細胞（A-ECs）聯繫起來。多重免疫螢光將ESM1定位於VWF陽性血管結構，並顯示HLS卵巢中ESM1陽性面積顯著更大、VWF/ESM1雙陽性細胞更多（P < 0.05）。細胞間通訊分析識別出IGFBP3–TMEM219作為候選的內皮細胞－顆粒細胞相互作用。在內皮細胞條件培養基中檢測到了IGFBP3，其顯著降低了顆粒細胞中EdU的嵌合率以及CYP11A1、FSHR和STAR的表達（P < 0.05）。重組IGFBP3產生了類似的反應，而TMEM219敲減部分減弱了其中幾種效應。結論：本研究識別出探索性卵巢代謝模式與內皮細胞異質性之間的關聯，而功能實驗表明，源自內皮細胞的IGFBP3部分透過TMEM219影響顆粒細胞功能。這些發現表明內皮細胞狀態和信號傳導可能與卵泡發育有關，儘管IGFBP3–TMEM219信號傳導是否直接促成湖羊產羔數的變異仍有待確立。

papers.title: Baicalein and Neohesperidin Dihydrochalcone Improve Post-Thaw Sperm Quality and Modulate the Semen Supernatant Metabolome in Qinchuan Bulls
papers.abstract: Oxidative stress during cryopreservation compromises post-thaw sperm quality in bulls. This study evaluated the effects of baicalein (BAI), neohesperidin dihydrochalcone (NHDC) and their combined supplementation on Qinchuan bull sperm cryopreservation and the associated metabolic responses. Concentration screening identified 40 μg/mL BAI and 30 μg/mL NHDC for subsequent experiments. Compared with the control, BAI, NHDC and BAI + NHDC increased post-thaw sperm motility, plasma membrane integrity, acrosome integrity, adenosine triphosphate (ATP) content and mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP). The supplemented groups also showed lower reactive oxygen species (ROS) and malondialdehyde (MDA) levels; higher activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD), catalase (CAT), and glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px); and higher total antioxidant capacity (T-AOC). The combined treatment showed higher total motility, plasma membrane integrity, and acrosome integrity than either single treatment. Untargeted metabolomics identified 96, 123 and 197 differential metabolites in the BAI, NHDC and BAI + NHDC groups, respectively. Differential metabolites from all three treatments were enriched in lipid-related pathways, including glycerophospholipid metabolism and linoleic acid metabolism. Metabolites identified in the BAI + NHDC group were additionally enriched in nucleotide metabolism, purine metabolism, and ubiquinone-related pathways. BAI × NHDC interaction analysis identified 200 metabolites showing non-additive responses, with enrichment in lipid-related pathways, including glycerophospholipid metabolism and linoleic acid metabolism. Together, BAI and NHDC improved post-thaw sperm quality in Qinchuan bulls, accompanied by changes in oxidative status, mitochondrial function, and lipid- and energy-related metabolites.
papers.abstract_zh: 公牛冷凍保存過程中的氧化壓力會損害解凍後的精子品質。本研究評估了黃芩素（BAI）、新橙皮苷二氫查耳酮（NHDC）及其聯合添加對秦川牛精子冷凍保存及相關代謝反應的影響。濃度篩選確定了 40 μg/mL 的 BAI 和 30 μg/mL 的 NHDC 用於後續實驗。與對照組相比，BAI、NHDC 及 BAI + NHDC 組提高了解凍後精子活力、質膜完整性、頂體完整性、三磷酸腺苷（ATP）含量和線粒體膜電位（MMP）。添加組亦表現出較低的活性氧（ROS）和丙二醛（MDA）水平；較高的超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、過氧化氫酶（CAT）和穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶（GSH-Px）活性；以及較高的總抗氧化能力（T-AOC）。與單一處理相比，聯合處理顯示出更高的總活力、質膜完整性和頂體完整性。非標靶代謝體學在 BAI、NHDC 和 BAI + NHDC 組中分別鑑定出 96、123 和 197 個差異代謝物。所有三個處理組的差異代謝物均富集於脂質相關途徑，包括甘油磷脂代謝和亞麻油酸代謝。在 BAI + NHDC 組中鑑定的代謝物還額外富集於核苷酸代謝、嘌呤代謝及泛醌相關途徑。BAI × NHDC 交互作用分析鑑定出 200 個表現出非加成性反應的代謝物，其富集於脂質相關途徑，包含甘油磷脂代謝和亞麻油酸代謝。綜上所述，BAI 和 NHDC 改善了秦川牛解凍後的精子品質，並伴隨氧化狀態、線粒體功能以及脂質和能量相關代謝物的改變。

papers.title: Rumen-Protected Niacin Supplementation Modulates Uterine Arterial Hemodynamics and Endometrial Microbiome Functional Potential in Postpartum Japanese Black Cattle
papers.abstract: This study examined whether rumen-protected niacin (RPN) supplementation is associated with uterine hemodynamics and the postpartum uterine environment in Japanese Black cattle. Experiment 1 used a crossover design to evaluate acute uterine vascular responses to RPN in synchronized heifers (n = 6). Experiment 2 was an exploratory evaluation of postpartum cows (n = 6) during long-term RPN supplementation using uterine artery Doppler measurements, uterine inflammatory indicators, and endometrial microbiome analysis. In Experiment 1, high-dose RPN administration was associated with changes in uterine hemodynamic parameters (p < 0.05) and higher baseline-adjusted whole-blood NAD+ concentrations across the post-administration period (p < 0.001). In Experiment 2, RPN supplementation was associated with time-dependent differences in uterine hemodynamic parameters, whereas uterine inflammatory indicators were not significantly affected. Although broad treatment-associated differences in overall endometrial microbial diversity and community structure were not detected, exploratory differences in specific bacterial taxa were observed between treatment groups, and predicted metabolic pathways showed treatment-dependent temporal changes. Exploratory integrated analysis further identified concurrent within-animal patterns across uterine hemodynamics, microbial community structure, and predicted microbial functional potential. These exploratory findings suggest that RPN may modulate uterine hemodynamics and be associated with selective changes in the postpartum uterine environment, providing a basis for further investigation of the relationships among nutritional intervention, uterine hemodynamics, the endometrial microbial ecosystem, and subsequent reproductive physiology.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探討添加過胃 rumen-protected niacin (RPN) 是否與黑毛和牛之子宮血行動態及產後子宮環境有關。試驗一採用交錯設計（crossover design），評估同步化女牛（n = 6）對 RPN 之急性子宮血管反應。試驗二則為針對產後母牛（n = 6）進行長期 RPN 添加之探索性評估，評估項目包含子宮動脈杜卜勒超音波測量、子宮發炎指標以及子宮內膜微生物相分析。在試驗一中，高劑量 RPN 給藥與子宮血行動態參數之改變（p < 0.05）以及給藥後整體全血 NAD+ 濃度（經基線調整後）之升高有關（p < 0.001）。在試驗二中，RPN 添加與子宮血行動態參數之時間相依性差異有關，而子宮發炎指標則未受顯著影響。儘管未偵測到整體子宮內膜微生物多樣性與群落結構因處理而產生廣泛差異，但在處理組間觀察到特定細菌分類群的探索性差異，且預測代謝途徑顯示出具處理相依性的時間變化。探索性整合分析進一步識別出子宮血行動態、微生物群落結構以及預測微生物功能潛力之間，動物個體內同時存在的模式。這些探索性結果顯示，RPN 可能可調節子宮血行動態，並與產後子宮環境之選擇性改變有關，為進一步探討營養介入、子宮血行動態、子宮內膜微生物生態系統及後續繁殖生理之間的關係奠定基礎。

papers.title: Edge-Based Long-TermAutomated Monitoring of Budgerigar Vocal Activity Using YAMNet
papers.abstract: Continuous monitoring of animal behavior may provide quantitative information on responses to environmental changes; however, its application in seismobiological research requires reliable characterization of baseline behavioral variability. This study developed and evaluated an edge-based bioacoustic monitoring system for the continuous analysis of vocal activity in budgerigars (Melopsittacus undulatus). Ten birds were monitored under stable housing conditions from June 2025 to May 2026. Audio was processed locally on a Raspberry Pi-based system that combined a pretrained YAMNet feature extractor with a task-specific binary classifier. Vocal activity was quantified using the vocal activity second (VAS), defined as a 1 s interval containing at least one detected vocalization. Time-series analysis revealed a pronounced diel organization of vocal activity, with increased activity during daylight hours and minimal activity at night, together with seasonal variability. Wavelet and periodogram analyses identified a periodic component near 24 h, with weaker components within the 2–8 h range. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of autonomous edge-based monitoring of avian vocal behavior and establish a quantitative analysis of acoustic activity. The present study represents a methodological framework for the collection and analysis of avian acoustic signals using machine learning and computational signal processing approaches. The proposed approach provides a quantitative framework for investigating changes in avian behavior and for evaluating whether potential behavioral responses in vocal organization are associated with environmental factors.
papers.abstract_zh: 持續監測動物行為有助於提供其對環境變遷反應的量化資訊；然而，其在地震生物學研究中的應用，需要對基準行為變異性進行可靠的特徵化。本研究開發並評估了一種基於邊緣運算（edge-based）的生物聲學監測系統，用於持續分析虎皮鸚鵡（Melopsittacus undulatus）的發聲活動。研究於 2025 年 6 月至 2026 年 5 月期間，在穩定的飼養條件下監測了 10 隻鳥類。音訊由基於 Raspberry Pi 的系統進行本地處理，該系統結合了預訓練的 YAMNet 特徵提取器與特定任務的二元分類器。發聲活動以「發聲活動秒數」（vocal activity second, VAS）進行量化，定義為包含至少一次檢測到之發聲的 1 秒區間。時間序列分析顯示出顯著的晝夜發聲活動規律，白天活動增加而夜間活動極少，同時伴隨季節性變異。小波分析與週期圖分析識別出接近 24 小時的週期性成分，以及 2–8 小時範圍內較弱的成分。這些發現證明了自主式邊緣運算鳥類發聲行為監測的可行性，並建立了聲學活動的定量分析。本研究為使用機器學習與計算信號處理方法收集和分析鳥類聲學信號提供了方法學框架。所提出的方法為研究鳥類行為的變化以及評估發聲組織中潛在的行為反應是否與環境因素相關，提供了定量框架。

papers.title: Diagnostic Value of the Vertebral Right Heart Index (VRHi) for Identifying Pulmonary Hypertension in Dogs with Heartworm Disease
papers.abstract: Pulmonary hypertension (PH) is a common complication of canine heartworm disease caused by Dirofilaria immitis and is associated with right-sided cardiac remodelling. This study evaluated the diagnostic value of the Right Vertebral Heart Index (VRHi) for identifying dogs with a high echocardiographic probability of PH and its association with echocardiographic indices of right-sided cardiac remodelling. Fifty-four dogs from Gran Canaria were included: 20 healthy controls and 34 dogs naturally infected with D. immitis, classified according to the presence or absence of a high echocardiographic probability of PH. Thoracic radiographs were obtained without sedation, and the vertebral heart size (VHS) and VRHi were measured using DICOM software. Heartworm infection was confirmed using a commercial antigen detection test. Echocardiography was performed to assess parasite burden, determine the probability of PH, and evaluate right-sided cardiac remodelling. Dogs with a high echocardiographic probability of PH showed more frequent clinical signs and greater echocardiographic evidence of right-sided cardiac remodelling than dogs without PH. The VRHi values differed significantly among the three study groups and were highest in dogs with a high echocardiographic probability of PH. The VRHi was significantly correlated with echocardiographic indicators of right-sided remodelling. The right lateral projection showed the highest AUC among VRHi measurements (AUC = 0.835), although its AUC did not differ significantly from that of conventional VHS (AUC = 0.764; DeLong p = 0.519). These findings suggest that VRHi may provide a simple and objective complementary radiographic parameter in dogs with heartworm disease and suspected PH.
papers.abstract_zh: 肺動脈高壓（PH）是由犬惡絲蟲（Dirofilaria immitis）引起的犬心絲蟲病之常見併發症，並與右心重塑有關。本研究旨在評估右側椎骨心臟指數（VRHi）用於識別具備高超音波心動圖肺動脈高壓機率之犬隻的診斷價值，及其與右心重塑超音波指標的相關性。本研究納入來自大加納利島的54隻犬：20隻健康對照犬以及34隻自然感染犬惡絲蟲的犬隻，並根據是否具有高超音波心動圖肺動脈高壓機率進行分類。在無鎮靜狀態下拍攝胸部X光，並使用DICOM軟體測量椎骨心臟尺寸（VHS）與VRHi。心絲蟲感染係利用商業抗原檢測試劑確認。進行超音波心動圖檢查以評估寄生蟲負荷、判定肺動脈高壓機率，以及評估右心重塑。與無肺動脈高壓的犬隻相比，具備高超音波心動圖肺動脈高壓機率的犬隻表現出更頻繁的臨床症狀以及更顯著的右心重塑超音波證據。三組研究對象間的VRHi數值存在顯著差異，且以具備高超音波心動圖肺動脈高壓機率的犬隻最高。VRHi與右心重塑的超音波指標呈顯著相關。在所有VRHi測量值中，右側臥位投影顯示最高的曲線下面積（AUC = 0.835），儘管其AUC與傳統VHS（AUC = 0.764；DeLong p = 0.519）無顯著差異。這些發現表明，對於患有心絲蟲病且懷疑有肺動脈高壓的犬隻，VRHi可提供一個簡單且客觀的輔助X光放射學參數。

papers.title: Breed Composition and Heterozygosity in Brangus and Braford Composite Cattle Breeds
papers.abstract: Composite cattle breeds are developed to combine favorable traits from parental populations and to exploit heterosis across diverse production environments. However, their genomic structure becomes progressively more complex across generations, and it remains unclear to what extent patterns of local ancestry and heterozygosity are conserved across breeds. The objective of this study was to characterize genomic breed composition in Argentine Brangus and Braford at both global and local levels, and to identify shared genomic segments with extreme values of indicine ancestry and heterozygosity. A total of 783 animals from six breeds were analyzed using SNP data. Global ancestry proportions were estimated using STRUCTURE, whereas local ancestry was inferred through haplotype phasing (Shapeit5) and local ancestry inference using LOTER. Deviations between observed and expected breed composition and heterozygosity were evaluated at the SNP level using chi‐square tests with multiple testing correction. Shared genomic segments were defined as contiguous genomic intervals composed of SNPs showing significant deviations in both breeds. Brangus and Braford showed lower indicine proportions than the expected 37.5%, with reductions of 1.2% and 7.1%, respectively. Local ancestry analysis revealed heterogeneous genomic patterns, with shared segments enriched for indicine ancestry on chromosomes 3, 6, 20, and 28. In contrast, segments with reduced indicine ancestry were more broadly distributed. No SNP exceeded the expected heterozygosity; however, multiple regions showed significant reductions, particularly on chromosome 18. These results demonstrate that Brangus and Braford exhibit complex and heterogeneous genomic architectures, with shared genomic regions showing extreme patterns of ancestry and heterozygosity.
papers.abstract_zh: 複合肉牛品種的培育旨在結合親本群體的優良性狀，並在不同的生產環境中利用雜種優勢。然而，其基因體結構在跨世代間變得日益複雜，且局部祖先來源（local ancestry）與雜合度（heterozygosity）的模式在不同品種間保留的程度仍不清楚。本研究旨在於全基因體與局部層次上描述阿根廷布蘭格斯牛（Brangus）與布拉佛牛（Braford）的基因體品種組成，並識別具有極端瘤牛（indicine）祖先比例與雜合度數值的共享基因體片段。本研究使用單核苷酸多型性（SNP）資料，分析了來自六個品種共 783 頭動物。全基因體祖先比例利用 STRUCTURE 進行估計，而局部祖先則是透過單套型分型（Shapeit5）與利用 LOTER 的局部祖先推論來推斷。透過卡方檢定及多重檢定校正，在 SNP 層次上評估觀察到的與預期的品種組成及雜合度之間的偏差。共享基因體片段被定義為由在兩個品種中皆顯示顯著偏差的 SNP 所構成的連續基因體區間。布蘭格斯牛與布拉佛牛顯示出低於預期 37.5% 的瘤牛比例，分別減少了 1.2% 與 7.1%。局部祖先分析揭示了異質性的基因體模式，其中富含瘤牛祖先的共享片段位於第 3、6、20 和 28 染色體上。相比之下，瘤牛祖先減少的片段分佈更為廣泛。沒有任何 SNP 超過預期的雜合度；然而，多個區域顯示出顯著的減少，特別是在第 18 染色體上。這些結果證明了布蘭格斯牛與布拉佛牛展現出複雜且具異質性的基因體架構，其中共享的基因體區域顯示出祖先來源與雜合度的極端模式。

papers.title: Effects of Dietary Bacillus spp. and Bacillus spp.-Fermented Soybean Hull on Growth Performance and Apparent Nutrient Digestibility in Growing–Finishing Pigs
papers.abstract: This study investigated the fermentation improvement of soybean hull by Bacillus subtilis and Bacillus licheniformis from Ningxiang pigs and evaluated different feeding methods in growing-finishing pigs. The cellulase-producing capacity of the two strains and their fermentation effects on soybean hull were determined. Compound Bacillus preparation (200 and 400 g/t) and fermented soybean hull (5% and 10%) were supplemented into finishing pig diets, and their effects on growth performance; apparent nutrient digestibility; and serum biochemical, immune, and antioxidant indices were evaluated. In vitro results showed that combined fermentation significantly decreased crude fiber content and increased crude protein and ether extract concentrations. Animal trial results showed that supplementation with 400 g/t compound Bacillus preparation or 5% fermented soybean hull significantly increased final body weight but did not significantly affect average daily gain (ADG), average daily feed intake (ADFI), or feed-to-gain ratio (F/G). In the compound Bacillus preparation trial, supplementation increased the apparent digestibility of crude protein and gross energy and was associated with changes in several serum antioxidant and inflammatory indicators. In the fermented soybean hull trial, supplementation improved crude protein utilization efficiency, with no significant effects on the measured serum immune parameters. Supplementation with 200 g/t compound Bacillus preparation or 10% fermented soybean hull showed no growth-promoting effects. Neither method adversely affected the measured growth performance, nutrient digestibility, or serum parameters. The present study demonstrates that appropriate doses of Ningxiang pig-derived compound Bacillus preparation or its fermented soybean hull can increase final body weight and nutrient digestibility in growing–finishing pigs. These findings provide experimental support for the application of Bacillus spp. in feed fermentation and finishing pig production.
papers.abstract_zh: 本研究探討利用源自寧鄉豬的枯草芽孢桿菌（Bacillus subtilis）與地衣芽孢桿菌（Bacillus licheniformis）改善大豆皮醱酵之效果，並評估其在生長肥育豬中的不同飼餵方式。測定了兩株菌株的產纖維素酶能力及其對大豆皮的醱酵效果。在肥育豬日糧中添加複合芽孢桿菌製劑（200與400克/噸）以及醱酵大豆皮（5%與10%），並評估其對生長性能、養分表觀消化率、血清生化、免疫及抗氧化指標的影響。體外試驗結果顯示，混合醱酵顯著降低了粗纖維含量，並提高了粗蛋白質與乙醚萃取物的濃度。動物試驗結果顯示，添加400克/噸複合芽孢桿菌製劑或5%醱酵大豆皮顯著提高了最終體重，但對平均日增重（ADG）、平均日採食量（ADFI）或料重比（F/G）無顯著影響。在複合芽孢桿菌製劑試驗中，添加該製劑提高了粗蛋白質和總能的表觀消化率，並與多項血清抗氧化及發炎指標的變化有關。在醱酵大豆皮試驗中，添加該組分提高了粗蛋白質利用效率，且對所測定的血清免疫參數無顯著影響。添加200克/噸複合芽孢桿菌製劑或10%醱酵大豆皮則未顯示出生長促進效果。兩種方法均未對所測定的生長性能、養分消化率或血清參數產生不良影響。本研究證明，適當劑量的寧鄉豬源性複合芽孢桿菌製劑及其醱酵大豆皮可提高生長肥育豬的最終體重與養分消化率。這些發現為芽孢桿菌屬在飼料醱酵與肥育豬生產中的應用提供了實驗支持。

papers.title: Dynamics of Gut Microbial Community and Function in Growing Male Raccoon Dogs
papers.abstract: Background: Raccoon dogs have short breeding cycles and strong adaptability, and their fur is economically valuable. Although the gut microbiota, a key regulator of animal health, has been extensively studied in livestock, its composition and function in raccoon dogs remain poorly understood. Methods: In this study, the gut microbiota structure and functional profiles of ten raccoon dogs were analyzed during their growth period, including 2 (M2), 3 (M3), 4 (M4), 6 (M6), and 8 (M8) months after birth. Results: Our findings revealed that the richness and diversity of the gut microbiota in growing raccoon dogs increased initially and then decreased with age. Significant intergroup separation was observed in principal coordinates analysis (PCoA) and non-metric multidimensional scaling (NMDS) analyses, while the unweighted pair–group method with arithmetic means (UPGMA) analysis indicated temporal fluctuations in microbial composition. At the phylum level, the dominant taxa were Firmicutes, Bacteroidota, Actinobacteriota, and Proteobacteria. At the genus level, the M2 group was enriched with Ligilactobacillus and Megasphaera; the M3 group with Blautia, Megamonas, Peptoclostridium, and Prevotella 9; the M4 group with Cetobacterium and Streptococcus; the M6 group with Lactobacillus and Prevotella 9; and the M8 group with Prevotella 9 and Turicibacter. Function prediction of gut microbiota identified metabolism (particularly carbohydrate, amino acid, energy, and nucleotide metabolism) and genetic information processing (including replication and repair) as the predominant functional categories. Conclusions: The present results offer an understanding of how the gut microbiota of growing raccoon dogs changes over time.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：貉具有短繁殖周期與強大適應能力，且其毛皮具有經濟價值。儘管腸道微生物相作為動物健康的關鍵調節因子，已在家畜中受到廣泛研究，但其在貉體內的組成與功能仍所知甚少。方法：本研究分析了十隻生長期貉在出生後 2（M2）、3（M3）、4（M4）、6（M6）及 8（M8）個月等不同發育階段的腸道微生物相結構與功能特性。結果：研究發現，隨著年齡增長，生長期貉腸道微生物相的豐富度與多樣性呈現先增加後下降的趨勢。主座標分析（PCoA）與非度量多維度尺度分析（NMDS）顯示顯著的組間分離，而未加權成對群平均法（UPGMA）分析則指出微生物組成的時間動態波動。在門的層級下，優勢菌群為厚壁菌門（Firmicutes）、擬桿菌門（Bacteroidota）、放線菌門（Actinobacteriota）與變形菌門（Proteobacteria）。在屬的層級下，M2 組富含固醇乳桿菌屬（Ligilactobacillus）與巨球形菌屬（Megasphaera）；M3 組富含布勞氏菌屬（Blautia）、巨單胞菌屬（Megamonas）、消化梭菌屬（Peptoclostridium）及普雷沃氏菌屬 9（Prevotella 9）；M4 組富含鯨桿菌屬（Cetobacterium）與鏈球菌屬（Streptococcus）；M6 組富含乳桿菌屬（Lactobacillus）及普雷沃氏菌屬 9（Prevotella 9）；M8 組則富含普雷沃氏菌屬 9（Prevotella 9）與動彎桿菌屬（Turicibacter）。腸道微生物相功能預測顯示，代謝（特別是碳水化合物、胺基酸、能量與核苷酸代謝）以及遺傳訊息處理（包含複製與修復）為主要的優勢功能類別。結論：本研究結果提供了對生長期貉腸道微生物相隨時間演變之理解。

papers.title: Physiological Adaptations of Tibetan Antelopes to High-Altitude Hypoxia: Insights from Pulmonary and Vasoactive Peptide Studies
papers.abstract: The Qinghai–Tibetan Plateau is characterized by persistent hypobaric hypoxia, and Tibetan antelopes (Pantholops hodgsonii) exhibit exceptional athletic performance under extreme oxygen-deficient conditions. This study conducted a comparative analysis of pulmonary hemodynamics, ventilatory regulation, vasoactive peptides, and cardiopulmonary ultrastructure among 10 Tibetan antelopes, 10 high-altitude sheep, and 8 low-altitude sheep under normoxia, mild hypoxia, and severe hypoxia. The findings revealed that Tibetan antelopes possess a lower baseline mean pulmonary arterial pressure (mPAP) compared to high-altitude sheep, with values similar to those of low-altitude sheep. Under hypoxic conditions, antelopes experienced a mild increase in mPAP, whereas sheep exhibited significant vasoconstriction. Additionally, antelopes demonstrated a reduced hypoxic ventilatory response, in contrast to sheep, which increased total ventilation. Antelopes also had lower levels of plasma endothelin-1, nitric oxide synthase, arterial oxygen pressure, and blood oxygen saturation, with no significant differences observed in blood pH, carbon dioxide pressure, and lactate levels among the groups. Ultrastructural analyses indicated that Tibetan antelopes possess a higher density of alveolar lamellar bodies and myocardial mitochondria. These traits minimize energy use during breathing, prevent pulmonary hypertension, and maintain excellent movement ability in high-altitude, low-oxygen environments.
papers.abstract_zh: 青藏高原以持續性低壓缺氧為特徵，而藏羚羊（Pantholops hodgsonii）在極端缺氧環境下展現出卓越的運動能力。本研究對 10 隻藏羚羊、10 隻高海拔綿羊和 8 隻低海拔綿羊在常氧、輕度缺氧與重度缺氧條件下的肺部血行動力學、通氣調節、血管活性肽以及心肺超微結構進行了比較分析。研究結果顯示，與高海拔綿羊相比，藏羚羊具有較低的基礎平均肺動脈壓（mPAP），其數值與低海拔綿羊相似。在缺氧條件下，藏羚羊的 mPAP 僅輕微上升，而綿羊則表現出顯著的血管收縮。此外，藏羚羊表現出較低的缺氧通氣反應，這與總通氣量增加的綿羊形成對比。藏羚羊的血漿內皮素-1、一氧化氮合酶、動脈氧分壓和血氧飽和度水準也較低，而各組間的血液 pH 值、二氧化碳分壓和乳酸水準則無顯著差異。超微結構分析表明，藏羚羊具有較高密度的肺泡板層小體和心肌粒線體。這些特徵能最大限度地減少呼吸過程中的能量消耗、預防肺動脈高壓，並在高海拔低氧環境中維持優異的運動能力。

papers.title: Opportunities for creating a circular economy in the Australian poultry industry
papers.abstract: SUMMARYApproximately one third of the world’s food production is ultimately wasted. Current estimates suggest that the amount of land used to grow food that is wasted is greater than twice the landmass of Australia, and Australia itself wastes a landmass larger than the state of Victoria. With over 2 billion people suffering from food insecurity, an estimated world population of 9.7 billion by 2050, and ongoing detrimental environmental damage caused by industrialisation, there is ever increasing motivation to develop new and effective strategies to maximise efficiency in utilising the world’s available natural resources. In order to begin planning, an understanding of the present is required. Over the last 25 years, the idea of recycling food waste as animal feed on an industrial scale has become a focus for many researchers and agricultural industries. In particular, the poultry industry is well situated to take advantage, as it is an industry that already uses by-products and is intensive in nature and often integrated. A literature review was conducted to compare existing studies on the amount and value of wasted food and resources, the nutritional composition of various streams of food waste, and its potential application as poultry feed. This review explored global studies, ultimately focusing on an Australian context; a country in which poultry is the highest consumed protein source per capita. Many causes of food waste were identified, as well as several emerging strategies to combat this. While nutritional variability is a commonly noted issue, the consensus among researchers is that, depending on the source, food waste could feasibly be used to substitute conventional ingredients such as corn and soybean meal in poultry diets without production loss, with likely economic advantages.
papers.abstract_zh: 總結大約全球三分之一的糧食生產最終遭到浪費。目前的估計顯示，用於生產被浪費食物的土地面積大於澳洲本土面積的兩倍，而澳洲本身浪費的土地面積則比維多利亞州還要大。在超過 20 億人口面臨糧食不安全、預計到 2050 年世界人口將達到 97 億，以及工業化持續造成環境破壞的情況下，開發新且有效的策略以最大化利用全球可用自然資源的動機日益強烈。為了開始進行規劃，必須先對現狀有所理解。在過去 25 年中，以工業規模將廚餘回收作為動物飼料的理念已成為許多研究人員和農業產業的焦點。特別是，家禽產業非常適合從中受益，因為這是一個已經在使用副產品、具有集約化特點且通常呈垂直整合的產業。本研究進行了一項文獻回顧，旨在比較現有關於被浪費食物和資源的數量與價值、各類廚餘的營養成分，以及其作為家禽飼料之潛在應用的研究。本研究探討了全球性研究，並最終聚焦於澳洲本土的情境；在該國，家禽是每人平均消費量最高的蛋白質來源。本研究指出了浪費食物的許多原因，以及多種應對此問題的新興策略。儘管營養成分的變異性是一個經常被提及的問題，但研究人員的共識是，視來源而定，廚餘切實可用於替代家禽飼料中的傳統原料（如玉米和大豆粕），且不會造成生產損失，同時可能帶來經濟效益。

papers.title: Effects of Nest Box Lighting on Nest Box Use in Four Commercial Layer Strains Reared Cage-Free
papers.abstract: Laying hens exhibit strong motivations for environmental features including secluded nest sites and specific lighting conditions, yet research comparing preferences across commercial layer strains in cage-free systems remains limited. This study examined nest box use under four lighting conditions (monochromatic red LED, monochromatic blue LED, UVA LED, or dark) in four commercial layer strains—three White Leghorn strains (Hy-Line W36, Hy-Line W80, and Lohmann LSL) and one brown layer strain (Hy-Line Brown)—reared under identical cage-free conditions. Sixty birds per strain were housed in a single floor pen per strain (four pens in total), each with an eight-nest, two-tier nest box unit, and the location of eggs laid in nest boxes was recorded at 45 days during early lay. The percentage of eggs laid under each condition was used as an indirect measure of preference. Within each flock, lighting condition affected nest box use (p < 0.001). Overall, more eggs than expected by chance were laid in dark (33.12%) and red-lit (29.51%) nest boxes, and fewer in UV (21.46%) and blue-lit (15.91%) nest boxes. The three White Leghorn flocks used dark nest boxes most, whereas the Hy-Line Brown flock used red-lit boxes most (36.36%), and blue-lit boxes were the least used in all flocks. Use of top- versus bottom-row nest boxes also differed among flocks. Because each strain was represented by a single pen, strain and pen effects are confounded, and differences among strains should be considered preliminary and hypothesis-generating. Replicated studies are needed before strain-specific nest box lighting recommendations can be made.
papers.abstract_zh: 產蛋雞對環境特徵（包含隱蔽的產巢區及特定的光照條件）表現出強烈的動機，然而針對無籠飼系統中不同商業蛋雞品系偏好之比較研究仍相當有限.本研究探討了四種商業蛋雞品系（三個白來亨雞品系：Hy-Line W36、Hy-Line W80、Lohmann LSL，以及一個褐殼蛋雞品系：Hy-Line Brown）在四種光照條件（單色紅光 LED、單色藍光 LED、UVA LED 或黑暗）下的產巢箱使用情形，這些雞隻均在相同的無籠飼條件下飼養.每品系有六十隻雞，飼養於各品系專屬的單一地面平飼欄中（共四欄），每欄皆設有一個八巢、雙層的產巢箱單元，並記錄產於產巢箱內的雞蛋位置，時間為產蛋初期共 45 天.產在各條件下的雞蛋百分比作為偏好的間接測量指標.在每個雞群中，光照條件皆會影響產巢箱的使用（p < 0.001）.整體而言，產在黑暗（33.12%）及紅光（29.51%）產巢箱中的雞蛋多於隨機期望值，而產在紫外線（21.46%）及藍光（15.91%）產巢箱中的雞蛋則較少.三個白來亨雞群最常使用黑暗產巢箱，而 Hy-Line Brown 雞群則最常使用紅光產巢箱（36.36%），且藍光產巢箱在所有雞群中的使用率皆最低.上層與下層產巢箱的使用情形在各雞群之間亦有不同.由於每個品系僅代表單一雞欄，因此品系與雞欄效應存在混淆，品系間的差異應被視為初步且具假設生成性質.在提出針對特定品系的產巢箱光照建議之前，仍需進行重複性研究.

papers.title: Comprehensive Non-Specific Immune and Gene Expression Profiling of FACS-Sorted Hemocyte Subpopulations in Litopenaeus vannamei After Vibrio parahaemolyticus (AHPND Strain) Infection
papers.abstract: Vibrio parahaemolyticus is the causative agent of acute hepatopancreatic necrosis disease (AHPND) in white shrimp aquaculture, which often causes high mortality. Circulating hemocytes play a central role during vibriosis infection, however, the hemocyte subpopulation specific responses to VP-AHPND infection remain poorly understood. This study used flow cytometry and fluorescence-activated cell sorting (FACS) to characterize four hemocyte subpopulations (H1–H4), including prohemocyte (H1), hyalinocyte (H2), semi-granulocyte (H3), and granulocyte (H4) based on non-specific immune functions and gene-expression profiles after VP-AHPND infection. Differentially hemocyte counts changed dynamically over 48 h, revealing hemocyte subpopulation specific responses to infection, which are H1 peaked during 6 h post infection, H2 increased for most of the period, whereas H3 and H4 declined at 24 and 48 h, respectively. Gene set variation analysis revealed marked early activation (6 hpi) of coagulation and notch-1 in the H1 subpopulation. The H2 subpopulation showed enrichment of pattern-recognition and coagulation genes, which mostly enhanced in the 12 hpi. Meanwhile, genes associated with prophenoloxidase and antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) were strongly upregulated especially in the late sampling time point (24 and 48 h), coinciding with a decrease in the percentages of their corresponding hemocytes (H3 and H4 subpopulation). These findings reveal that VP infection triggers a coordinated, subpopulation-specific innate immune response instead of a uniform reaction across all hemocytes. By integrating the relative proportions of hemocyte subpopulations, non-specific immune, and gene-expression, this study offers new mechanistic insights into shrimp cellular immunity and highlights key hemocyte subpopulations and pathways as potential targets for enhancing disease resistance in white shrimp aquaculture.
papers.abstract_zh: 副溶血性弧菌（Vibrio parahaemolyticus）是造成白蝦養殖場急性肝胰腺壞死症（AHPND）的病原體，經常引發高死亡率。循環血球在弧動菌病感染期間扮演核心角色，然而，對於血球亞群對VP-AHPND感染的特異性反應所知仍相當有限。本研究利用流式細胞儀與螢光啟動細胞分選術（FACS），根據VP-AHPND感染後的非特異性免疫功能與基因表現圖譜，對四種血球亞群（H1–H4）進行特徵分析，包含原血球（H1）、透明血球（H2）、半顆粒血球（H3）及顆粒血球（H4）。不同血球計數在48小時內呈現動態變化，顯示血球亞群對感染具有特異性反應：H1在感染後6小時達到高峰，H2在大部分期間增加，而H3與H4則分別在第24及48小時下降。基因集變異分析顯示，H1亞群中的凝血與notch-1在早期（感染後6小時）即有顯著活化。H2亞群顯示模式識別與凝血基因的富集，這些基因多半在感染後12小時增強。同時，與原酚氧化酶和抗菌肽（AMPs）相關的基因則強烈顯著上調，特別是在較晚的採樣時間點（24與48小時），這與其對應血球（H3與H4亞群）百分比的下降吻合。這些發現揭示了VP感染會觸發協調的、具亞群特異性的先天免疫反應，而非所有血球產生一致的反應。透過整合血球亞群的相對比例、非特異性免疫與基因表現，本研究為蝦類細胞免疫提供了新的機制見解，並突顯關鍵的血球亞群與路徑，可作為提升白蝦養殖抗病能力的潛在標的。

papers.title: Short-Term Associations Between a Government-Funded Sterilization Program for Owned Outdoor Dogs and Abandonment-Related Shelter Admissions in the Republic of Korea: A Nationwide Municipality-Level Panel Study
papers.abstract: Sterilization programs for owned outdoor dogs aim to reduce uncontrolled breeding and subsequent abandonment, but population-level evidence remains limited. This study examined short-term associations between the Korean government-funded sterilization program introduced in 2022 and shelter-recorded abandoned-dog admissions using annual data from 229 municipalities from 2019 to 2024 (1374 municipality-year observations). The outcome was shelter-recorded abandoned-dog admissions per 100,000 residents. Socioeconomic associations, program implementation, and implementation volume were evaluated using two-way fixed-effects (TWFE) and difference-in-differences (DID) models. Estimates were interpreted as ecological associations because parallel pre-intervention trends could not be fully established, program allocation was non-random, and eligible owned outdoor dog populations were unavailable. In the primary linear TWFE models, neither program implementation nor implementation volume was significantly associated with the shelter-recorded abandoned-dog admissions, and urban–rural-stratified analyses yielded similar null findings. Baseline-need-scaled sensitivity analyses produced positive associations in the pooled and urban samples, indicating sensitivity to denominator choice and model specification. Province-specific analyses were heterogeneous but inconsistent. Overall, the analyses provided no consistent evidence of a short-term reduction associated with the program. Future evaluations should measure coverage among eligible owned outdoor dogs, use longer follow-up, and evaluate sterilization within broader dog population management.
papers.abstract_zh: 有主戶外犬隻的絕育計畫旨在減少不受控制的繁殖與隨之而來的棄養，但族群層級的證據仍然有限。本研究檢視了2022年實施的韓國政府資助絕育計畫與收容所記錄的棄養犬隻收容數之間的短期關聯，使用了來自229個行政區從2019年至2024年的年度資料（共1,374筆行政區-年份觀察值）。結果變項為每10萬名居民收容所記錄的棄養犬隻收容數。本研究使用雙向固定效果（TWFE）與雙差分（DID）模型，評估了社會經濟相關因素、計畫實施情況以及實施數量。由於無法完全建立平行的介入前趨勢、計畫分配並非隨機，且缺乏符合資格的有主戶外犬隻族群數據，因此估計值被解釋為生態學上的相關性。在主要的線性TWFE模型中，計畫的實施與實施數量皆與收容所記錄的棄養犬隻收容數無顯著關聯，城鄉分層分析也得出相似的無顯著效果發現。以基準需求規模調整的敏感度分析在合併樣本與城鄉樣本中產生了正向關聯，顯示結果對分母選擇與模型設定具敏感性。各省的分析結果具異質性但不一致。整體而言，分析未提供該計畫與短期減少之間具一致性的證據。未來評估應測量符合資格的有主戶外犬隻涵蓋率、使用更長的追蹤期，並在更廣泛的犬隻族群管理架構下評估絕育效果。

papers.title: Transcriptome Analysis Reveals the Effects of Dietary DHA and EPA on the Hepatic Response to Unpredictable Chronic Stress in Atlantic Salmon (Salmo salar L.)
papers.abstract: Eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) are key long-chain omega-3 fatty acids in fish nutrition, but their differential effects on Atlantic salmon under unpredictable chronic stress (UCS) remain unclear. This study compared hepatic responses to DHA- and EPA-rich diets under unstressed and UCS conditions. Atlantic salmon post-smolts were fed a low-EPA+DHA, DHA-rich, or EPA-rich diet for 10 weeks, followed by 3 weeks of UCS. Liver transcriptomes were analyzed by RNA sequencing, and selected genes were validated by quantitative reverse transcription PCR. Growth did not differ among dietary groups. Under unstressed conditions, the DHA-rich diet induced more differentially expressed genes than the EPA-rich diet (67 vs. 29) and affected pathways related to fatty acid metabolism, autophagy, cholesterol homeostasis, and antioxidant defense. After UCS, the EPA-rich diet induced a broader hepatic transcriptional response than the DHA-rich diet (205 vs. 57 differentially expressed genes), with only 12 genes shared between the two comparisons. Both diets affected fatty acid- and steroid-biosynthesis-related pathways, while gene-level responses were diet-specific. These findings reveal distinct, stress-dependent hepatic responses to dietary DHA and EPA and may inform future optimization of their nutritional provision in Atlantic salmon production.
papers.abstract_zh: 二十碳五烯酸（EPA）與二十二碳六烯酸（DHA）是大西洋鮭魚營養中的關鍵長鏈 omega-3 脂肪酸，但它們對處於不可預測之慢性壓力（UCS）下的大西洋鮭魚之差異性影響仍不清楚。本研究比較了在無壓力與 UCS 條件下，富含 DHA 與富含 EPA 飲食的肝臟反應。大西洋鮭魚後 smolt 分別投餵低 EPA+DHA、富含 DHA 或富含 EPA 的飼料 10 週，隨後進行 3 週的 UCS。利用 RNA 定序分析肝臟轉錄體，並透過即時定量反轉錄聚合酶連鎖反應（qRT-PCR）驗證部分基因。各飲食組間的生長情形無顯著差異。在無壓力條件下，富含 DHA 的飲食比富含 EPA 的飲食誘導出更多的差異表現基因（67 個對 29 個），並影響與脂肪酸代謝、自噬作用、膽固醇恆定及抗氧化防禦相關的通路。在 UCS 之後，富含 EPA 的飲食比富含 DHA 的飲食誘導出更廣泛的肝臟轉錄反應（205 個對 57 個差異表現基因），且兩者比較中僅有 12 個基因重疊。兩種飲食皆影響與脂肪酸及類固醇生物合成相關的通路，而基因層面的反應則具飲食特異性。這些發現揭示了飲食中 DHA 與具壓力依賴性的相異肝臟反應，並可為未來優化大西洋鮭魚生產中的營養供給提供參考。

papers.title: Berberine Protects Brain Endothelial Barrier via β-Catenin: A Network Pharmacology in Pigs and In Vitro Mechanistic Analysis
papers.abstract: Glaesserella parasuis (G. parasuis) is an important swine pathogen that causes Glässer’s disease, of which meningitis is among the most severe clinical symptoms. However, the molecular mechanisms underlying G. parasuis-induced meningitis remain poorly understood. In this study, we employed a network pharmacology-based strategy combined with in vitro experimental validation to investigate the protective effects and mechanisms of berberine against G. parasuis meningitis. Network pharmacology analysis identified CTNNB1 (encodes the β-catenin protein) as a core target among multiple candidate targets. Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analyses revealed that the predicted targets of berberine are significantly associated with inflammatory signaling (mitogen-activated protein kinase MAPK/nuclear factor kappa B NF-κB) and stress-response pathways (forkhead box O FoxO/p53), suggesting a multifaceted protective mechanism against G. parasuis-induced blood–brain barrier (BBB) disruption. Molecular docking results combined with drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS) assays demonstrated that berberine binds directly to β-catenin with high affinity (docking score = −7.52 kcal/mol), as evidenced by enhanced proteolytic stability of β-catenin upon berberine (2.5, 10, and 20 μg/mL) treatment.
